breeds.name: Feca
breeds.description: Fecas are faithful protectors, always on the defensive. They hold an important place in groups of adventurers because of their protective powers enabling them to take massive hits in stride. They're also experts in the art of magic signs - when there's going to be a fight, the Fecas get out their glyphs!

primary.name: Drowsiness
primary.description: Inflicts Earth damage on enemies in an area of effect and reduces their AP.

variant.name: Manœuvre
variant.description: Inflicts Air damage on enemies and switches places with the target.

primary.name: Languor
primary.description: Removes Intelligence and Critical, and inflicts Fire damage.

variant.name: Lifelessness
variant.description: Inflicts Fire damage and removes MP from enemies in an area of effect.

primary.name: Rampart
primary.description: Reduces damage suffered by the caster and their allies in an area of effect.

variant.name: Fortification
variant.description: Reduces damage suffered by the targeted ally.

primary.name: Typhoon
primary.description: Removes Agility and Damage and inflicts Air damage on enemies in an area of effect.

variant.name: Gust
variant.description: Inflicts Air damage on enemies and repels targets in an area of effect.

primary.name: Shiver
primary.description: Inflicts Air damage on enemies and attracts targets towards the targeted cell in an area of effect.

variant.name: Sudden Shower
variant.description: Inflicts Water damage on enemies and repels the target.

primary.name: Barricade
primary.description:
Makes the targeted ally Invulnerable in Close Combat.
Increases the ally's MP when attacked from long range or unbewitched.

On a free cell: summons a static shield that places a glyph-aura, making allies Invulnerable in Close Combat.
The glyph follows the shield, and it is destroyed on the following turn.

variant.name: Pavise
variant.description:
Summons multiple static shields in an area of effect.
The shields are destroyed on the following turn.

On a target: summons these shields adjacent to the target.
• On an ally: the Pavises are destroyed at the start of the ally's turn or when the ally dies.
• On an enemy: the Pavises are destroyed on the following turn.

primary.name: Distrust
primary.description:
Increases the targeted ally's Lock for each enemy adjacent to them, and places an end-of-turn glyph that inflicts Earth, Fire, Water and Air damage on enemies.
Increases the close-combat resistances of allies present in or entering the glyph.

Also summons the Shepherd's Lantern, applies the spell's effects on it and allows it to lock if the cell is free.

variant.name: Barrier
variant.description:
Applies the Gravity and Barrier states to the target.

On an enemy:
• At the start of their turn, places a glyph that inflicts Earth, Fire, Water and Air damage around the target.
• Increases the ranged resistances of allies present in or entering the area of effect.
• The glyph only inflicts damage on the enemy if they go through it.
• The states and glyph are removed if the enemy goes through the Barrier or if they are killed.

On an ally:
• The glyph is placed at end of the caster's turn and only inflicts damage on the first enemy that goes through it.
• The states and glyph are removed if the target or an enemy goes through the Barrier.

On a free cell: summons the Shepherd's Lantern and applies the spell's effects on it.

primary.name: Lethargy
primary.description: Inflicts Fire damage and reduces MP.

variant.name: Gather the Flock
variant.description: Attracts targets towards the centre and inflicts Earth damage on enemies in an area of effect.

primary.name: Nimbus
primary.description: Removes Chance and Lock and inflicts Water damage on enemies in an area of effect.

variant.name: Stratus
variant.description: Inflicts Water damage and removes Range from enemies in an area of effect.

primary.name: Bastion
primary.description:
Makes the targeted ally Invulnerable at Range.
Increases their Power if they are attacked in close combat or unbewitched.

On a free cell: summons a static shield that places a glyph-aura, making allies Invulnerable at Range.
The glyph follows the shield, and it is destroyed on the following turn.

variant.name: Truce
variant.description: Places a glyph-aura that makes entities Pacifist.

primary.name: Backlash
primary.description: Removes Strength and Dodge and inflicts Earth damage.

variant.name: Tetany
variant.description: Inflicts Earth damage and removes AP.

primary.name: Bubble
primary.description: Inflicts Water damage and reduces Range.

variant.name: Cowbell
variant.description: Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and attracts the targets up to the centre in an area of effect.

primary.name: Silbo
primary.description:
Inflicts Air damage on enemies and pushes targets back from the centre in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Shepherd's Crook
variant.description: Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and attracts the target.

primary.name: Torpor
primary.description: Attracts the target and inflicts Earth damage on enemies.

variant.name: Getaway
variant.description: Moves the caster away from the target and inflicts Water damage on enemies.

primary.name: Into the Fold
primary.description:
Places a glyph-aura that applies the Unshakable and Gravity states on entities.
Also applies the Shepherd's Star on allies present in or entering the glyph.

variant.name: Excursion
variant.description:
Places a glyph that switches the allies' places with the caster's.
Also applies the Shepherd's Star on allies who trigger the glyph.

primary.name: Feca Shield
primary.description:
Reduces damage suffered by the targeted ally.
Also applies the Shepherd's Star state to the targeted ally and all allies present in an allied elemental glyph.

variant.name: Reinforced Protection
variant.description:
Increases the caster's characteristics based on their active elemental armour, triggers their elemental glyphs on the targeted cell, and applies the Shepherd's Star on allies present in these glyphs.

The glyphs can only be triggered manually once per turn.

primary.name: Backup
primary.description: Teleports the caster to the targeted ally.

variant.name: Ataraxia
variant.description:
Applies the Gravity state on the targeted ally and reduces all types of damage suffered on the first attack.
The spell's effects are removed upon suffering any attack.

Interception and damage-sharing effects are incompatible with the spell.

primary.name: Prairie
primary.description:
Places a start-of-turn glyph that inflicts Air damage on enemies.
Reduces the final damage of enemies present in or entering the glyph.

Also summons the Shepherd's Lantern if the cell is free.
Prevents the use of other elemental glyphs in the same turn.

variant.name: Pastureland
variant.description:
Inflicts Air damage on enemies in an area of effect and places a glyph-aura under the target that increases allies' final damage.

Also summons the Shepherd's Lantern if the cell is free.

Prevents the use of other elemental glyphs in the same turn.
Dissipates the spell's previously placed glyph-aura.

primary.name: Valley
primary.description:
Places a start-of-turn glyph that inflicts Water damage on enemies.
Removes Range from enemies present in or entering the glyph.

Also summons the Shepherd's Lantern if the cell is free.
Prevents the use of other elemental glyphs in the same turn.

variant.name: Black Ice
variant.description:
Inflicts Water damage on enemies in an area of effect and places a glyph-aura under the target that increases allies' Dodge.

Also summons the Shepherd's Lantern if the cell is free.

Prevents the use of other elemental glyphs in the same turn.
Dissipates the spell's previously placed glyph-aura.

primary.name: Dirt Floor
primary.description:
Places a start-of-turn glyph that inflicts Earth damage on enemies.
Removes AP from enemies present in or entering the glyph.

Also summons the Shepherd's Lantern if the cell is free.
Prevents the use of other elemental glyphs in the same turn.

variant.name: Refuge
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage on enemies in an area of effect and places a glyph-aura under the target that reduces damage suffered by allies.

Also summons the Shepherd's Lantern if the cell is free.

Prevents the use of other elemental glyphs in the same turn.
Dissipates the spell's previously placed glyph-aura.

primary.name: Greener Pastures
primary.description:
Teleports the caster and triggers their elemental glyphs on the targeted cell.
Also applies the Shepherd's Star on allies present in the triggered glyphs.

The glyphs can only be triggered manually once per turn.

variant.name: Aegis
variant.description:
Summons a static shield that intercepts damage suffered by allies within its glyph-aura and applies the Shepherd's Star state on them.
The glyph follows the shield, and it is destroyed 2 turns after being summoned.

On a target: places a glyph-aura that intercepts damage suffered by allies and applies the Shepherd's Star state on them.

Does not affect the Barricade or the Bastion.

primary.name: Scorched Dirt
primary.description:
Places a start-of-turn glyph that inflicts Fire damage on enemies.
Removes MP from enemies present in or entering the glyph.

Also summons the Shepherd's Lantern if the cell is free.
Prevents the use of other elemental glyphs in the same turn.

variant.name: Lookout
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect and places a glyph-aura under the caster that increases allies' Range.
The glyph-aura is placed on the targeted cell if it is free or if the target is an ally.

Also summons the Shepherd's Lantern if the cell is free.

Prevents the use of other elemental glyphs in the same turn.
Dissipates the spell's previously placed glyph-aura.

breeds.name: Osamodas
breeds.description: Osamodas are born creature tamers! They have the power to summon creatures and they are the greatest trainers. Rumour has it that they even cut their clothes from the skin of their enemies. Go ask them whether it's true or not... If you're on their side, they'll always be on hand with a minor heal. If not, well, we'll see if you end up as a boot or a fur-lined hat.

primary.name: Crobak Call
primary.description:
Steals HP from enemies or heals allies in the Air element.
Also increases the caster's and targeted ally's MP.

Heals do not affect the caster.

variant.name: Fangs of Boowolf
variant.description: Inflicts Earth damage on enemies and increases the caster's and their allies' close-combat damage in an area of effect.

primary.name: Prespic Peaks
primary.description:
Steals HP from enemies or heals allies in the Fire element.
Also increases the caster's and targeted ally's Critical Hits.

Heals do not affect the caster.

variant.name: Plucking
variant.description: Inflicts Air damage and reduces enemies' Pushback Resistance in an area of effect.

primary.name: Piranya Teeth
primary.description:
Heals allies and steals HP in the Water element from enemies in an area of effect.
Also increases the caster's and targeted allies' Damage.

Heals do not affect the caster.

variant.name: Wild Heart
variant.description: Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and increases heals received by the caster and allies in an area of effect.

primary.name: Bear Cry
primary.description:
Heals allies and steals HP in the Earth element from enemies in an area of effect.
Also increases the caster's and targeted allies' Power.

Heals do not affect the caster.

variant.name: Toad Slobber
variant.description: Inflicts Water damage on and removes Damage from enemies in an area of effect.

primary.name: Whip
primary.description:
Inflicts damage on enemies in the caster's best element and repels the target.
If target is an allied summons, also increases the target's MP.

variant.name: Crop
variant.description:
Attracts targets towards the centre and inflicts damage in the caster's best element on enemies in an area of effect.
Teleports the targets symmetrically in relation to the centre if the centre cell is occupied.

Does not directly affect the caster.

primary.name: Tofu
primary.description: Summons a biddable tofu that can inflict Air damage, heal, remove Lock, and repel.

variant.name: Chtiger Claws
variant.description: Inflicts Fire damage and reduces the healing received by the target.

primary.name: Gobball
primary.description: Summons a biddable gobball that can inflict Earth damage, heal, remove Dodge, and teleport itself.

variant.name: Vulture Talons
variant.description: Inflicts Air damage on enemies and heals their attackers in an area of effect.

primary.name: Sweetoad
primary.description: Summons a biddable sweetoad that can inflict damage and apply a Water poison, heal, increase or remove Range, and move away.

variant.name: Golden Fleece
variant.description: Applies a shield on allies and inflicts Earth damage on enemies in an area of effect.

primary.name: Dragoone
primary.description: Summons a biddable dragoone that can inflict Fire damage, heal, remove Power, and switch positions.

variant.name: Snake Bite
variant.description: Increases the damage suffered by the target and applies a start-of-turn Water poison to them.

primary.name: Wild Procession
primary.description:
Increases the caster's Summons and reduces the AP cost of Osamodas summoning spells.

All Osamodas summons die at the start of the caster's turn if the caster is under the effects of the spell.

variant.name: Bestial Pact
variant.description:
Applies the Bestial state on the caster:
• Increases the caster's AP.
• Sacrifices all their current and future Osamodas summons to increase their damage and final heals.
• Transfers some of the sacrificed summons' health to the caster.
• The effects are greater based on the summons' SP cost.

Gobgobs are not affected by the spell.
The state and AP bonus duration is longer if the caster summons an Osamodas creature.
The cooldown period of Osamodas summoning spells is reset, and the spell's effects are removed if the state is lost or if the spell is recast.

primary.name: High-Energy Shot
primary.description:
Increases the target's AP and MP.
The effects are greater on summons.

variant.name: Animal Communion
variant.description:
Shares damage between the caster and an allied summons.

• On the caster: shares damage among all their summons.

primary.name: Leap-Froog
primary.description:
Teleports the caster symmetrically in relation to the target and inflicts Water damage on enemies.
If target is a summons, also teleports it symmetrically in relation to the caster.

variant.name: Feather Tornado
variant.description: Teleports the caster to the targeted cell, inflicts Air damage on enemies and repels targets from the centre in an area of effect.

primary.name: Draconic Breath
primary.description: Moves the caster away from the targets, inflicts Fire damage on enemies and repels targets in an area of effect.

variant.name: Crackler Punch
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage and attracts the targets up to the centre in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Bestial Charge
primary.description:
Moves the caster closer to the target and inflicts Earth damage on enemies.
Also attracts summons up to the centre in an area of effect around the target.

variant.name: Song of the Phoenix
variant.description: Heals allies, inflicts Fire damage on enemies and repels targets from the centre in an area of effect.

primary.name: Air Ace
primary.description:
Moves the caster closer to the target, inflicts Air damage on enemies and repels the target.
If target is a summons, also repels entities adjacent to the target.

variant.name: Whirlwind
variant.description: Teleports allies symmetrically in relation to the centre and inflicts Water damage on enemies in an area of effect.

primary.name: Discipline
primary.description: Inflicts damage in the caster's best element, removes MP from enemies, and attracts the target.

variant.name: Swift Whip
variant.description:
Attracts all the caster's summons towards the target and inflicts damage on enemies in the caster's best element.

Osamodas summons also attack if they are within range of the target and in its line of sight.
The summons' damage and healing are reduced by 50% while the spell is being used.
• Tofu: Kiss Kiss Peck Peck
• Gobball: Leap-Gobball
• Sweetoad: Croaking
• Dragoone: Dracorage
• Tofurby: Tofurback
• Gobbulky: Gobbulky Charge
• Sweetoadie: Toadcrobat
• Wyrmling: Dragon's Breath
• Scarabolt: Scarafuse
• Crackolossus: Rocky Sling

primary.name: Tofurby
primary.description: Summons a biddable tofurby that can inflict Air damage, increase Dodge, teleport itself, teleport entities symmetrically, repel, and move closer.

variant.name: Crackolossus
variant.description: Summons a biddable crackolossus that can inflict Earth damage, attract, remove MP, and increase resistances.

primary.name: Gobbulky
primary.description: Summons a biddable gobbulky that can inflict Earth damage, reduce damage suffered, move closer, and attract.

variant.name: Crocurmudgeon
variant.description: Summons a biddable crocurmudgeon that can inflict Water damage, remove Critical, and reduce heals and damage received.

primary.name: Sweetoadie
primary.description: Summons a biddable sweetoadie that can inflict damage and apply a Water poison, increase MP, repel, and teleport itself symmetrically.

variant.name: Sulphoenix
variant.description: Summons a biddable sulphoenix that can inflict Fire damage, heal, and teleport itself.

primary.name: Wyrmling
primary.description: Summons a biddable wyrmling that can inflict Fire damage, increase Power, and repel.

variant.name: Scarabolt
variant.description: Summons a biddable scarabolt that can inflict Air damage, teleport itself, remove Critical odds, and apply shield.

primary.name: Spiritual Leash
primary.description:
Applies the On a Leash state to the target for the current turn:
• Follows the caster immediately and when they use MP.

On the caster: applies the state to all their summons.

The state is removed if the caster or the target are moved.

variant.name: Spirit Relay
variant.description:
Switches places with one of the caster's summons and applies the Relay state to it:
• Future switches will be done between the summons in the state and the next targeted summons or the caster.

Switches are only applied if summons are within 5 cells of the caster.

primary.name: Gluttonous Spirit
primary.description:
Summons a controllable Gluttonous Gobgob that can inflict Neutral damage based on its health, kill allied summons to increase its Vitality, intercept an ally's damage, and teleport itself while creating illusions.

The cooldown period is fixed when the Gobgob dies.

variant.name: Mischievous Spirit
variant.description:
Summons a controllable mischievous gobgob that can switch positions, reduce the duration of effects, and sacrifice itself to copy an Osamodas summons.

The cooldown period is fixed when the gobgob dies.

breeds.name: Enutrof
breeds.description: Enutrofs are treasure hunters who are completely smitten with kamas, and who can, despite their advanced age, run like Dragoturkeys at the sight of a full vault. They're experts at slowing their enemies down; they can also bore them to tears - just before beating them over the head with a shovel when the time comes!

primary.name: Coin Throwing
primary.description: Inflicts Water damage.

variant.name: Hard Cash
variant.description:
Inflicts Air damage and applies the Hard Cash state on the targeted enemy:
• Inflicts Air damage if the target is hit by an attempted AP reduction.

The damage may be triggered 4 times, as long as the state is active.
The state is removed when the limit is reached.

primary.name: Ghostly Shovel
primary.description: Reduces effect duration on the target and inflicts Fire damage on enemies.

variant.name: Last Resort
variant.description: Applies the Gravity state on the targets and inflicts Air damage on enemies in an area of effect.

primary.name: Living Bag
primary.description:
Summons a biddable Living Bag that intercepts damage to allies located in its summoning area.
The Living Bag is destroyed 3 turns after being summoned.

When it is attacked by an ally, the ally is healed.

variant.name: Living Satchel
variant.description:
Summons a biddable Living Satchel that shares damage among all allies in its summoning zone.
The Living Satchel is destroyed 2 turns after being summoned.

When it is attacked by an ally, the ally gets healed.

primary.name: Shovel Kiss
primary.description: Inflicts Fire damage.

variant.name: Collapse
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage and applies the Collapse state on the targeted enemy:
• Inflicts Earth damage if the target suffers a Range reduction.

The damage may be triggered 4 times as long as the state is active.
The state is removed when the limit is reached.

primary.name: Bankruptcy
primary.description:
Inflicts Air damage and removes AP Parry.
The damage is greater on summons.

variant.name: Shovel Throwing
variant.description: Inflicts Earth damage and removes Range.

primary.name: Goldrush
primary.description:
Increases the targeted ally's MP and applies the Goldrush state on them:
• Increases the target's Power on the following turn if it ends its turn adjacent to an enemy, and heals the target if it ends its turn adjacent to an Enutrof summons.

variant.name: Wandering
variant.description: Reduces the duration of the effects on the target and switches its position with the caster's Living Bag or Living Satchel.

primary.name: Pandora's Box
primary.description: Heals all allies but increases the MP of all enemies.

variant.name: Toolbox
variant.description:
Increases the targeted ally's AP and MP but makes the ally Pacifist.
Also makes all of the targeted ally's summons Pacifist.

primary.name: Prime of Life
primary.description: Inflicts Earth damage and increases the caster's MP.

variant.name: Placer Mining
variant.description:
Inflicts Water damage and applies the Placer Mining state on the targeted enemy:
• Inflicts Water damage if the target is hit by an attempted MP reduction.

The damage may be triggered 4 times, as long as the state is active.
The state is removed when the limit is reached.

primary.name: Treasure Key
primary.description: Removes Range from enemies or increases the targeted ally's Range.

variant.name: Armlock
variant.description: Heals the targeted ally and removes unparryable MP.

primary.name: Tunnel
primary.description: Switches places with the target and inflicts Earth damage on enemies.

variant.name: Spade of the Ancients
variant.description: Inflicts Air damage on and removes AP from enemies, and repels targets from the centre in an area of effect.

primary.name: Living Shovel
primary.description:
Summons a biddable Living Shovel that can push targets.

When it is attacked by an ally, the ally gets healed.

variant.name: Living Spade
variant.description:
Summons a biddable Living Spade that can steal health in the Earth element and give Dodge.

When it is attacked by an ally, the ally gets healed.

primary.name: Miserliness
primary.description:
Removes unparryable MP to increase targets' AP in an area of effect around the caster.
Also removes Power from all entities outside the area of effect to increases the caster's Power for each entity hit (stackable 10 times).

variant.name: Decadence
variant.description:
Removes AP from enemies.

On an ally: immediately increases their final damage inflicted, but reduces it on the following turn.

primary.name: Auriferous Shovel
primary.description: Inflicts Water damage and removes MP.

variant.name: Peat Bog
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage in an area of effect.
The spell damage is increased for each MP used in the current turn.

primary.name: Clumsiness
primary.description: Subtracts MP.

variant.name: Golden Age
variant.description:
Makes the targeted ally Unlockable.
Increases its Power on the following turn.

primary.name: Mound
primary.description:
Inflicts Earth damage and removes Range in an area of effect.
The damage is greater on summons.

Does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Mine Fire
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage.
Entities that attack the target are healed by some of the damage inflicted.

primary.name: Opportuneness
primary.description: Inflicts Air damage and increases the caster's Power.

variant.name: Firedamp Explosion
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect and applies the Firedamp Explosion state on the target:
• Inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect around the target if it is healed.

The damage may be triggered 4 times, as long as the state is active.
The state is removed when the limit is reached.

primary.name: Loafylactic
primary.description: Inflicts Air damage and removes AP.

variant.name: Obsolescence
variant.description:
Inflicts Water damage and reduces MP Parry.
The damage is greater on summons.

primary.name: Pull Out
primary.description:
Immobilises targets and applies the Gravity state on everyone except the caster.
Immobilises the caster on the following turn.

variant.name: Lucky Shovel
variant.description:
Summons a static Lucky Shovel.
When summoned, and then at the start of each turn, it increases the caster's Power, Dodge, AP Reduction and MP Reduction.

The Lucky Shovel is destroyed 2 turns after being summoned, but heals the caster.

When it is attacked by an ally, the ally is healed.

primary.name: Bribery
primary.description:
Makes the targeted enemy Pacifist and Invulnerable.

On an ally: makes them Pacifist and heals them.

variant.name: Lucky Tunnel
variant.description:
Makes the caster invisible and applies the Lucky Tunnel state on them:
• Increases their Power on the following turn for each MP that they used.

primary.name: Expiry
primary.description:
Inflicts Fire damage.
Inflicts additional Fire damage on summons.

variant.name: Sieving
variant.description:
Inflicts Water damage and removes MP in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Shovel of the Ancients
primary.description: Inflicts Water damage on and removes MP from enemies, and repels the target.

variant.name: Deposit
variant.description: Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and heals allies in an area of effect at the start of their turns.

primary.name: Living Chest
primary.description:
Summons a biddable Living Chest that can lock, inflict Water damage and reveal invisible entities.

When it is attacked by an ally, the ally is healed.

variant.name: Living Trunk
variant.description:
Summons a biddable Living Trunk that can heal.

When it is attacked by an ally, the ally gets healed.

breeds.name: Sram
breeds.description: Srams are assassins who love purses, especially when they're full! Folding up the tails of a new tunic, exploring the bottom of a pocket, nimbly fingering through the contents, stroking the valuables and drawing out the prize is what a Sram enjoys best - apart from placing deadly traps and administering mortal blows, of course...

primary.name: Invisibility
primary.description:
Makes the target invisible.
It target is an ally, also increases their MP.

The cooldown period is reset when the caster kills a fighter.

variant.name: Mist
variant.description:
Places a glyph-aura that makes allies invisible and removes Range from enemies.

The cooldown period is reduced when the caster kills a fighter.

primary.name: Tricky Trap
primary.description: Places a trap that inflicts Fire damage on enemies and attracts entities towards its centre in an area of effect.

variant.name: Waylaying
variant.description:
Steals health in the Water element from enemies and attracts the target.
Entities that attack the targeted enemy are healed for some of the damage inflicted.

Draws the target toward the caster's double when it is on the field.

primary.name: Gangsterdom
primary.description: Steals Power and inflicts Earth damage.

variant.name: Pitfall
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage.
The spell's damage increases for each of the caster's traps that is triggered.

The effects are removed after the spell has been used.

primary.name: Arsenic
primary.description: Removes Range and applies a start-of-turn Air poison on the target.

variant.name: Toxines
variant.description:
Applies an end-of-turn Air poison on the targeted enemy.

While the poison is active, if the target suffers trap damage, the spell's damage increases (stackable 5 times) and the poison is reapplied.
This effect can only be triggered once per turn.

primary.name: Repelling Trap
primary.description: Places a trap that pushes entities away from its centre and inflicts Air damage on enemies in an area of effect.

variant.name: Frightful Trap
variant.description: Places a single-cell trap that inflicts Earth damage on enemies and pushes entities away from the centre in an area of effect.

primary.name: Deviousness
primary.description: Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and repels the target.

variant.name: Cut-Throat
variant.description: Inflicts Fire damage and increases the damage suffered by the target.

primary.name: Double
primary.description:
Summons a controllable double that has the same characteristics as the summoner.

It does not attack and dies at the end of its second turn to switch places with the caster and increase their MP.

variant.name: Plotter
variant.description:
Summons a controllable double that has the same characteristics as the summoner.

It does not attack and dies at the end of its third turn to inflict damage in its best element on adjacent entities.
When the double dies, the damage is increased for each of the caster's traps triggered after it was summoned.

primary.name: Miry Trap
primary.description: Places a trap that inflicts Water damage and removes MP.

variant.name: Epidemic
variant.description:
Applies an end-of-turn Air poison on the targeted enemy and applies the Epidemic state on the enemy:
• Spreads the poison and the state to enemies in an area of effect around the target at the end of its turn.

The caster and their double can act as a target to spread the poison.
Does not affect static summons.

primary.name: Shakedown
primary.description: Steals Strength and health in the Earth element.

variant.name: Perquisition
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and repels the target.

Repels the target from the caster's double when the double is on the field.

primary.name: Cruelty
primary.description:
Inflicts Water damage and increases the caster's MP.
The damage does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Jinx
variant.description:
Steals HP in the Water element and minimises the targeted enemy's random effects.
Also heals allies (except the caster) based on the damage inflicted on the targeted enemy in an area of effect.

Effect minimisation only works every other turn on the same target.

primary.name: Malevolent Trap
primary.description:
Places a trap that inflicts Earth damage.
The trap's damage increases with each enemy in an area of effect around the trap before its effects are applied.

variant.name: Break-In
variant.description: Steals Pushback Resistance and inflicts Fire damage.

primary.name: Paralysing Trap
primary.description: Places a trap that removes MP from enemies in an area of effect.

variant.name: Mass Grave
variant.description: Places a single-cell trap that applies the Gravity state to entities in an area of effect.

primary.name: Sickrat Trap
primary.description: Places a single-cell trap that draws entities towards its centre and inflicts Water damage on enemies in an area of effect.

variant.name: Fragmentation Trap
variant.description:
Places a single-cell trap that inflicts Fire damage in an area of effect.
The damage is greater on the central cell, based on the distance from the trap.

If an ally triggers the trap, they are not affected.

primary.name: Con
primary.description: Steals Agility and HP in the Air element.

variant.name: Larceny
variant.description:
Erodes the targets and inflicts Water damage in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Raiding
primary.description: Steals Chance and health in the Water element.

variant.name: Lethal Attack
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage.
The damage is greater on targets with less than 50% of their HP.

primary.name: Fear
primary.description: Pushes the target to the targeted cell.

variant.name: Misconstrual
variant.description:
Switches places with the target.
Switches the positions of the target and the caster's double when the double is on the field.

Dissipates the caster's Invisibility.

primary.name: Mistake
primary.description:
Erodes the targets and inflicts Air damage in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Perfidy
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage.
The spell's AP cost is lowered for each of the caster's triggered traps.

The effects are removed after the spell has been used.

primary.name: Chakra Concentration
primary.description:
Applies the Chakra Concentration state on the targeted enemy:
• Steals HP from the target in the caster's best element if the target suffers trap damage.

Dissipates the caster's Invisibility.

variant.name: Plot
variant.description: Steals Dodge and Damage from enemies or increases the caster's and the targeted ally's.

primary.name: Lethal Trap
primary.description:
Places a trap that inflicts Earth damage.
The damage is greater on entities with less than 50% of their health points.

variant.name: Calamity
variant.description: Places a trap that steals Dodge and inflicts Water damage on enemies in an area of effect.

primary.name: Evasion
primary.description:
Reduces damage suffered by the targeted ally, makes them Unlockable and applies the Evasion state on them:
• Moves the target away from their attacker and increases their MP if attacked by an enemy (stackable 3 times).

The move does not inflict damage.

variant.name: Mortuary Mark
variant.description:
Increases the damage suffered by the target and erodes it.
Damage is greater based on the number of the caster's triggered traps.

Dissipates the caster's invisibility.

primary.name: Drift Trap
primary.description: Places a trap that inflicts Fire damage on enemies and pushes entities away from the centre in an area of effect.

variant.name: Insidious Trap
variant.description: Places a trap that applies an end-of-turn Air poison on enemies, inflicts Air damage on them, and attracts entities towards the centre in an area of effect.

primary.name: Furrow
primary.description:
Steals Intelligence and HP in the Fire element in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Toxic Injection
variant.description:
Removes MP and applies a start-of-turn Air poison to the target.
The spell's cooldown period is reduced for each of the caster's triggered traps.

breeds.name: Xelor
breeds.description: Xelors are magi who can influence time. They also command obedience from all related mechanisms like chimes, clocks and pendulums. Therefore, Xelors enjoy playing with time... either to slow down their enemies or to teleport themselves wherever they want.

primary.name: Teleportation
primary.description:
Teleports the caster symmetrically relative to the target.

Can generate a Telefrag.

The cooldown is reset when the caster generates or consumes a Telefrag.

variant.name: Astrolabe
variant.description:
Teleports the caster to the targeted cell or switches places with the target.

On the caster: teleports them to their previous position.

Can generate a Telefrag.

The cooldown is reset when the caster generates or consumes a Telefrag.

primary.name: Disruption
primary.description:
Teleports the target symmetrically in relation to the caster and steals HP in the Fire element from enemies.

Can generate a Telefrag.

variant.name: Cog
variant.description:
Teleports targets symmetrically in relation to the centre and steals HP in the Earth element from enemies in an area of effect.
Does not directly affect the caster.

Can generate a Telefrag.

primary.name: Souvenir
primary.description:
Teleports the target to its previous position and steals HP in the Air element from enemies.

Can generate a Telefrag.

variant.name: Permutation
variant.description:
Switches places with the target and steals HP in the Water element from enemies.

Can generate a Telefrag.

primary.name: Shrivelling
primary.description:
Inflicts Air damage.
If the target has Telefrag, the spell's damage increases each time it is cast.

variant.name: Hand
variant.description:
Applies a start-of-turn Earth poison and the Hand state on the target:
• Inflicts Earth damage if the target loses the Telefrag state.

Damage can only be triggered once per turn.

primary.name: Rewind
primary.description:
Teleports the target to its start-of-turn position.
If the target is an ally, effects are applied at the end of the target's turn.

Can generate a Telefrag.

variant.name: Remanence
variant.description:
Applies the Remanent state on the target:
• Teleports the target to its previous position for every MP the target uses.
• If the target is an ally, effects are applied at the end of the target's turn.

Can generate a Telefrag.

primary.name: Refraction
primary.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies.
If the target has Telefrag, spreads the Telefrag state and applies the effects in an area of effect.

Consumes the target's Telefrag state.

variant.name: Regulator
variant.description:
Reduces the duration of effects on the target and inflicts Earth damage on enemies.
Increases the spell's maximum number of casts per turn for the current turn if the target has Telefrag.

Consumes the target's Telefrag state.

primary.name: Accomplice
primary.description:
Summons a controllable Accomplice that serves as an obstacle.
The Accomplice gains MP when it enters the Telefrag state.
It also reflects part of the damage it suffers from its summoner onto enemies in an area of effect around it.

If the caster's Accomplice is still on the field when summoned again, the old one is destroyed to make room for the new one.

variant.name: Xelor's Dial
variant.description:
Summons a static Xelor's Dial that can remove AP from or give AP to Telefrag entities in an area of effect.
It can also reflect part of the damage it suffers onto its enemy attackers. It also reflects part of the damage it suffers from the caster onto enemies in an area of effect around it.

There can only be one Xelor's Dial per team. If the Dial is still on the field when summoned again, the old one is destroyed to make room for the new one.

primary.name: Frostbite
primary.description:
Teleports the target to its previous position and inflicts Water damage on enemies.

Can generate a Telefrag.

variant.name: Dust
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect.
Also teleports Telefrag targets in the area of effect symmetrically in relation to the centre before applying effects.

Can generate a Telefrag.

primary.name: Slow Down
primary.description:
Removes AP and inflicts Water damage.
If the target has Telefrag, steals instead of removing.

variant.name: Xelor's Sandglass
variant.description:
Removes AP from and inflicts Fire damage on enemies and applies the Sandglass state on the target:
• Inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect when the state expires.

The state duration is reduced for each Telefrag consumed on the target.

primary.name: Gear
primary.description:
Teleports targets symmetrically in relation to the centre and inflicts Earth damage on enemies in an area of effect.
The area-of-effect damage does not decrease with distance.
Does not directly affect the caster.

Can generate a Telefrag.

variant.name: Dropper
variant.description:
Teleports the target and the caster to their previous positions and inflicts Water damage on enemies.

Can generate a Telefrag.

primary.name: Temporal Haze
primary.description:
Immediately removes unparryable AP in an area of effect to increase them on the following turn.
The AP removal does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Conservation
variant.description:
Reduces damage suffered by the targeted ally and applies the Conservation state on the ally:
• Increases the target's AP for each enemy attack suffered (stackable 2 times).

primary.name: Distortion
primary.description:
Teleports targets to their previous positions and inflicts Air damage on enemies in an area of effect.
The area-of-effect damage does not decrease with distance.
Does not affect the caster.

Can generate a Telefrag.

variant.name: Sands of Time
variant.description:
Teleports the target to its previous position and inflicts Fire damage on enemies.
Rebounds on the nearest entity in a 2-cell circle.

The rebound originates at each target's starting position.

Can generate a Telefrag.

primary.name: Passage of Time
primary.description:
Increases the targeted ally's Dodge.
Teleports the target back to its previous position on the following turn.

Can generate a Telefrag.

variant.name: Premonition
variant.description:
Teleports the caster or switches their position with the entity on the targeted cell on the following turn.

Can generate a Telefrag.

primary.name: Dark Ray
primary.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect.
The spell's damage increases for each Telefrag entity in the area of effect before applying effects.
The area-of-effect damage does not decrease with distance.

Consumes the targets' Telefrag states.

variant.name: Drying Up
variant.description:
Inflicts Air damage on enemies.
Rebounds on the nearest entity in a 2-cell circle.
Also increases the caster's MP for each Telefrag entity that is hit.

Consumes the targets' Telefrag states.

primary.name: Paradox
primary.description:
On the caster's Accomplice or Xelor's Dial:
• Makes the summons Unmovable.
• Teleports entities symmetrically in relation to the summons in an area of effect around it.
• Sets the cooldown period of the caster's Accomplice and Xelor's Dial spells to 1 turn.
• At the start of the summons's turn, teleports these entities teleported symmetrically in relation to the summons again.

Does not affect the Synchro or the caster.

Can generate a Telefrag.

variant.name: Rift
variant.description:
Switches places with the caster's Accomplice or Xelor's Dial and sets their cooldown period to 1 turn.
At the end of the caster's turn, teleports the Accomplice or Dial to its previous position.

Prevents Telefrag from being applied on the Synchro for the current turn.

Can generate a Telefrag.

primary.name: Synchro
primary.description:
Summons a static Synchro that may inflict Air damage on enemies in an area of effect when it enters the Telefrag state.
The Synchro is destroyed after inflicting damage.

It is immune to the direct application of Telefrag, and to the end-of-turn effects of the Rewind and Remanence spells.

There can only be one Synchro per team. If the Synchro is still on the field when summoned again, the old one is destroyed to make room for the new one.

variant.name: Knell
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire, Water, Air and Earth damage on enemies in an area of effect.

Damage is increased for each Telefrag consumed since it was last cast.
The effects are removed after the spell has been used.

Requires consuming at least one Telefrag to be used.

primary.name: Petrification
primary.description:
Inflicts Water damage and removes AP.
If the target has Telefrag, the spell's AP cost is reduced after being cast (stackable 2 times).

Consumes the target's Telefrag state.

variant.name: Harmpit
variant.description:
Removes AP from and inflicts Air damage on enemies.
If the target has Telefrag, the spell inflicts extra Air damage on enemies in an area of effect on the targeted cell at the end of the caster's next turn.

Consumes the target's Telefrag state.

primary.name: Clock
primary.description:
Removes AP and inflicts Earth damage.
If the target has Telefrag, the spell's damage increases before its effects are applied.

Consumes the target's Telefrag state.

variant.name: Water Clock
variant.description:
Removes AP and inflicts Water damage.
Increases the caster's AP on the following turn if the target has Telefrag (stackable 3 times).

Consumes the target's Telefrag state.

primary.name: Xelor's Punch
primary.description:
Teleports the target symmetrically in relation to the caster and inflicts Earth damage on enemies.

Can generate a Telefrag.

variant.name: Pendulum
variant.description:
Teleports the caster symmetrically in relation to the target, inflicts Air damage on the targeted enemy and on enemies in an area of effect around the caster, and teleports the caster to their previous position.
The effects are applied only once per casting.

Can generate a Telefrag.

primary.name: Mummification
primary.description: Applies the Telefrag state on the caster, makes them Unlockable and increases their MP and their AP Reduction.

variant.name: Twenty-Fifth Hour
variant.description: Deactivates the Rooted, Unmovable and Gravity states on the caster for the current turn.

primary.name: Rhol Bak
primary.description:
Teleports everyone to their previous positions.

Can generate a Telefrag.

variant.name: Instability
variant.description:
Places a start-of-turn glyph that teleports targets to their previous positions.
Also places a glyph-aura that makes allies Unlockable and removes AP from enemies.

The glyph is triggered if the caster generates or consumes a Telefrag.

Can generate a Telefrag.

primary.name: Desynchronisation
primary.description:
Places a single-cell trap that teleports entities symmetrically in relation to the trap in an area of effect.

Can generate a Telefrag.

variant.name: Spacetime
variant.description:
Applies the Spacetime state on the target:
• Teleports the target and the target's attacker to their previous positions if it suffers damage.
• Also reflects part of the damage suffered by the target onto their attacker if a Telefrag enemy.

Can generate a Telefrag.

breeds.name: Ecaflip
breeds.description: Ecaflips are warrior gamblers who can be found anywhere they can win big or lose everything... True Ecaflips never stop gambling, and they always go all in. But be careful: this is a very serious matter for Ecaflips. They won't hesitate to gamble their lives on a throw of the dice to avoid paying their dues...

primary.name: Feline Spirit
primary.description:
Teleports the target randomly and symmetrically in relation to the caster, or the caster in relation to the target, inflicts Earth damage on enemies and increases the caster's Critical Resistance.

• Tails: randomness is removed to teleport the target.
• Heads: randomness is removed to teleport the caster.

Draws a Queen of Diamonds.

variant.name: Kraps
variant.description:
Inflicts Water damage on enemies and repels the targets from the centre in an area of effect.
Also increases the caster's Critical Damage.

Draws a Queen of Clubs.

primary.name: Summoning Claw
primary.description:
Summons a biddable Kitten that can steal HP in the Water element, give MP and teleport.
As long as it is alive, increases the caster's Power.

variant.name: Summoning Stroke
variant.description: Summons a biddable Kitten that can heal, teleport or switch places.

primary.name: Lucky Draw
primary.description:
Draws a random Card from Ecaflip's Poker.
Plays the Hand before Drawing if the Hand is full.

The spell's AP cost is reimbursed.

variant.name: Redistribution
variant.description:
Plays the Hand and Draws 4 random Cards from Ecaflip's Poker.

The spell's AP cost is reimbursed.

primary.name: Smell
primary.description:
Immediately removes unparryable AP to increase MP in an area of effect.
Removes unparryable MP to increase AP on the following turn.
The AP removal does not affect the caster.

Plays the Hand.

variant.name: Wheel of Fortune
variant.description:
Immediately minimises the random effects and increases the Critical odds of enemies in an area of effect on the following turn.
The effects are inverted on allies in an area of effect.

Immediately plays the Hand and discards it in order to recover the Table on the following turn.
The Hand is not discarded if no Cards are on the Table.

primary.name: Reflex
primary.description:
Inflicts Air damage and increases the caster's MP.
The damage does not affect the caster.

Draws a Jack of Spades.

variant.name: Lapping Up
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage and randomly removes MP or AP in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

• Tails: randomness is removed to remove MP.
• Heads: randomness is removed to remove AP.

Draws a King of Diamonds.

primary.name: Trickery
primary.description:
Steals HP from enemies or heals allies in the Air, Water, Fire or Earth element.
The AP cost, damage, heals and the attack element are modified randomly on each casting and when the caster lands a critical hit.

Draws a Card based on the casting conditions and the spell's element.
Plays the Hand before Drawing if the Hand is full.

variant.name: All or Nothing
variant.description:
Heals allies and inflicts damage in the caster's best element on enemies in an area of effect.
Healing increases based on the Cards on the Table, and damage increases based on the Cards in the Hand.

Discards Hand and recovers the Table.

primary.name: Catnip
primary.description: Increases the targeted ally's MP or teleports the caster to the targeted cell.

variant.name: Leap
variant.description:
Teleports the caster to the targeted cell or switches places with the target.
Increases the caster's and their allies' Dodge in an area of effect.

primary.name: Topkaj
primary.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies or heals allies.

Draws a Jack of Hearts.

variant.name: Playful Claw
variant.description:
Inflicts Water damage and reduces Critical Resistance in an area of effect.

Draws a King of Clubs.

primary.name: Jass
primary.description:
Inflicts Air damage and Draws a Queen of Spades.
Does not affect the caster.

Also reduces Pushback Resistance based on the Spades in Hand (stackable once per Card).
The spell's damage increases based on the Spades in Hand.

Plays Cards from the Spades suit if the caster initially has at least one of them in their Hand.

variant.name: Misfortune
variant.description:
Steals HP in the Water element and applies the Misfortune state on the targeted enemy:
• Inflicts Water damage at the end of the target's turn if it has not landed a critical hit during its turn.

Draws an Ace of Clubs.

primary.name: Heads or Tails
primary.description:
Inflicts Earth damage.

On the caster: randomly applies the Heads state or the Tails state and returns 1 AP to them.
• Tails: gives 1 AP.
• Heads: gives 1 MP.
• Casting the spell again in one state applies the other to oneself.

Draws a Jack of Diamonds.

variant.name: Bravado
variant.description:
Inflicts Air damage in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

The spell's damage increases with each attraction, pushback, position switch or teleportation performed by the caster.
The effects are removed after the spell has been used.

primary.name: Second Chance
primary.description:
Immediately reduces the damage suffered by the targeted ally but increases it on the following turn.

Immediately plays the Hand and discards it in order to recover the Table on the following turn.
The Hand is not discarded if no Cards are on the Table.

variant.name: Nine Lives
variant.description:
Heals the target immediately and on the following turns.

Draws a random Card from Ecaflip's Poker immediately and on the following turns.

primary.name: Bluff
primary.description:
Inflicts damage in one or more elements based on the Cards in the Hand and Plays the Hand.
Spell damage in an element increases based on the Cards.

If the Hand is empty: Draws 4 random Cards from Ecaflip's Poker before applying the spell's effects.

variant.name: Rekop
variant.description:
Uses the Winning Hand to inflict damage:
• Four Suits or Royal Straight with All Suits: damage in all elements.
• Royal Straight with One Suit: damage in the Suit's element per Card.
• Royal Straight: damage in the best element
• Pair: damage in the best element per Pair.
• Three of a Kind: damage in the best element per Three of a Kind Card.

Discards Hand.

primary.name: Pawpads
primary.description:
Moves the caster away from the target, repels the target and inflicts Air damage on enemies.

Draws a King of Spades.

variant.name: Yowling
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and repels targets in an area of effect.

Draws a King of Hearts.

primary.name: Yahtzee
primary.description:
Inflicts Water damage and increases the caster's Critical odds.
The damage does not affect the caster.

Draws a Jack of Clubs.

variant.name: Rough Tongue
variant.description:
Heals allies and inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

Draws a King of Hearts.

primary.name: Belote
primary.description:
Inflicts Earth damage on enemies and Draws a Queen of Diamonds.
Does not affect the caster.

Also reduces Critical Damage based on the Diamonds in Hand (stackable once per Card).
The spell's damage increases based on the Diamonds in Hand.

Plays Cards from the Diamonds suit if the caster initially has at least one of them in their Hand.

variant.name: Peril
variant.description:
Steals HP in the Fire element and applies the Peril state on the targeted enemy:
• Inflicts Fire damage and removes the state if the target is healed.

Draws an Ace of Hearts.

primary.name: Luck
primary.description:
Inflicts Water damage and Draws a Queen of Clubs.
Does not affect the caster.

Also reduces Critical based on the Clubs in Hand (stackable once per Card).
The spell's damage increases with each Club in Hand.

Plays Cards from the Clubs suit if the caster initially has at least one of them in their Hand.

variant.name: Nerve
variant.description:
Moves the caster closer to the target, steals HP in the Air element from enemies, repels the target and applies the Nerve state on the targeted enemy:
• Inflicts Air damage and removes the state if the target attracts, repels, switches places or inflicts pushback damage.

Draws an Ace of Spades.

primary.name: Roulette
primary.description:
Applies a random effect to everyone.

The spell's AP cost is reimbursed.

variant.name: Ecaflip's Tarot
variant.description: Draws a random Card from Ecaflip's Tarot to apply its effects on the caster and everyone.

primary.name: House of Cards
primary.description:
Applies a shield to the target for each Card in the Hand, based on the Card's value.

Plays the Hand.

variant.name: Lucky Star
variant.description:
Heals the target and applies the Lucky Star state on it:
• Applies a shield around the target if it lands a critical hit (stackable 5 times).

Draws a random Card from Ecaflip's Poker if the Hand is empty.

primary.name: Blakjak
primary.description:
Inflicts Fire damage and Draws a Queen of Hearts.
Does not affect the caster.

Also reduces healing received by the target based on the Hearts in Hand (stackable once per Card).
The spell's damage increases based on the Hearts in Hand.

Plays Cards from the Hearts suit if the caster initially has at least one of them in their Hand.

variant.name: Fate of Ecaflip
variant.description:
Steals HP in the Earth element from enemies, randomly attracts or repels the target, and applies the Fate of Ecaflip state on the targeted enemy:
• Inflicts Earth damage and removes the state if the target lands a critical hit.

• Tails: randomness is removed to attract the target.
• Heads: randomness is removed to repel the target.

Draws an Ace of Diamonds.

primary.name: Perception
primary.description: Heals the targeted ally for each enemy in the area of effect and reveals invisible entities in an area of effect.

variant.name: Predation
variant.description: Erodes enemies and reveals invisible entities in an area of effect.

primary.name: Balling Up
primary.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and attracts targets towards the centre in an area of effect.

Draws a Queen of Hearts.

variant.name: Claw of Ceangal
variant.description:
Repels the target, moves the caster closer to the target and inflicts Air damage on enemies.

Draws a Queen of Spades.

primary.name: Felintion
primary.description:
Moves the caster closer to the target, attracts the target and inflicts Water damage on enemies.

Draws a King of Clubs.

variant.name: Misadventure
variant.description:
Teleports targets symmetrically in relation to the centre, inflicts Earth damage on and randomly removes MP or AP from enemies in an area of effect.
Does not directly affect the caster.

• Tails: randomness is removed to remove MP.
• Heads: randomness is removed to remove AP.

Draws a King of Diamonds.

breeds.name: Eniripsa
breeds.description: Eniripsas are healers with the power to ease your pain with a single word. Their potent utterances can either heal their allies or hurt their enemies. Some Eniripsas become word hunters, wandering the earth in search of obscure verbs and forgotten languages!

primary.name: Friendship Word
primary.description:
Summons a biddable Coney that can heal or apply a shield.
If in the Controlled state, it can also transform to inflict damage in the Alchemical Rhetoric element.

The Coney is teleported to the targeted cell and immobilised if the spell is recast when it is alive.

When it dies, the caster places a glyph under the Coney, which inflicts damage on enemies or heals allies in the caster's best element, and the spell's cooldown period is set to 2 turns.

variant.name: Alchemical Word
variant.description:
Summons a static Empty Flask that can be filled with an element with Alchemical Rhetoric.
When the flask is attacked by an ally, the ally consumes its contents so that the caster heals them and increases their characteristics based on the contents.
When it is destroyed, the flask inflicts damage based on its contents on enemies and on the caster's other flasks in an area of effect.

On one of the caster's full flasks: consumes the flask's contents.
On one of the caster's empty flasks: destroys the flask and reimburses the AP cost.

Using the spell on a flask reimburses the use of the spell on the current turn.

primary.name: Raucous Word
primary.description: Heals allies and inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect.

variant.name: Deafening Cry
variant.description: Inflicts Fire damage and removes AP.

primary.name: Mischievous Word
primary.description: Inflicts Air damage and removes MP.

variant.name: Malicious Word
variant.description:
Inflicts Air damage and applies the Malice state on the target:
• Removes Power from the target for each MP it uses (stacks 10 times).

primary.name: Vampiric Word
primary.description: Steals health in the Water element from enemies or transfers part of the caster's health to the targeted ally.

variant.name: Sobs
variant.description: Inflicts Water damage on the target and heals allies based on the damage inflicted in an area of effect around the target.

primary.name: Stimulating Word
primary.description:
Increases the targeted ally's AP and applies the Encouraged state on the ally.
Stacking is shared among Encouragements.

On a free cell: summons a Stimulating Fairy.

variant.name: Word of Decline
variant.description:
Reduces the duration of effects on the targeted enemy, reduces its healing received, and applies the Mocked state on it.
Stacking is shared among Mockeries.

On a free cell: summons a Fire of Decline.

primary.name: Profanity
primary.description: Inflicts Earth damage on enemies and repels the target.

variant.name: Ancestral Ointment
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage on enemies or heals allies.
Also reduces healing received by the targeted enemy or increases healing received by the targeted ally.

primary.name: Warpaint
primary.description:
Paints the target and inflicts Earth damage on enemies or heals allies.

Paint State:
• On an enemy: reduces their Pushback Resistance.
• On an ally: heals at the start of their turn.

variant.name: Secret Word
variant.description:
Heals allies and inflicts Air damage on enemies in an area of effect.
Healing and damage is higher in 2 turns if the spell isn't cast again on the following turn.

Increases final healing from all the caster's Fairies if an entity is hit.

primary.name: Lamentations
primary.description:
Steals HP in the Water element from enemies and heals allies based on the damage inflicted in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Commotion
variant.description:
Heals allies or inflicts Fire damage on enemies.

On one of the caster's Will-o'-the-Wisps: applies the effects in an area of effect and increases the final damage of all the caster's Will-o'-the-Wisps.

primary.name: Turbulent Word
primary.description:
Heals allies, inflicts Fire damage on enemies and applies the Turbulent state to them in an area of effect:
• Repels entities adjacent to the target at the end of its turn.

variant.name: Furious Word
variant.description: Inflicts Earth damage on enemies and repels targets outwards in an area of effect.

primary.name: Life-Giving Word
primary.description:
Increases the targeted ally's MP and Dodge and applies the Encouraged state on the ally.
Stacking is shared among Encouragements.

On a free cell: summons a Life-Giving Fairy.

variant.name: Galvanising Word
variant.description:
Increases the targeted ally's Power and applies a shield and the Encouraged state on that ally.
Stacking is shared among Encouragements.

On a free cell: summons a Galvanising Fairy.

primary.name: Prankster's Word
primary.description:
Inflicts Air damage on enemies or heals allies and applies the Pranked state on the target:
• Teleports the target to its previous position at the end of its turn.

variant.name: Defensive Word
variant.description: Steals HP in the Water element from enemies and attracts targets towards the targeted cell in an area of effect.

primary.name: Flowery Word
primary.description:
Inflicts Air damage on enemies and applies the Flowering state on targets in an area of effect:
• Heals allies in an area of effect around the target at the end of their turn.

variant.name: Enchanted Thicket
variant.description:
Heals allies and inflicts Air damage on enemies in an area of effect.
The area of effect extends around the caster's Fairies and Encouraged allies.

The effects are applied only once per casting.

primary.name: Word of Youth
primary.description:
Reduces the duration of effects on the targeted ally, heals them immediately and at start of turn, and applies the Encouraged state on them.
Stacking is shared among Encouragements.

On a free cell: summons a Youth Fairy.

variant.name: Depressing Word
variant.description:
Removes Power and damage from the targeted enemy and applies the Mocked state on it.
Stacking is shared among Mockeries.

On a free cell: summons a Depressing Fire.

primary.name: War Cry
primary.description:
Inflicts Earth damage on enemies and repels the targets in an area of effect.
The area-of-effect damage does not decrease with distance.

variant.name: Ritual Word
variant.description:
Places a glyph-aura that paints entities in an area of effect.
Also inflicts Earth damage on enemies in the area of effect and heals allies inside the area of effect.

primary.name: Forbidden Word
primary.description: Reduces the duration of effects on the target, inflicts Water damage on enemies or heals allies.

variant.name: Bloodless Word
variant.description:
Inflicts Water damage and heals the target's attackers.

On an ally: heals the target.

primary.name: Overwhelming Word
primary.description:
Removes MP and MP Parry from the targeted enemy and applies the Mocked state on it.
Stacking is shared among Mockeries.

On a free cell: summons an Overwhelming Fire.

variant.name: Discouraging Word
variant.description:
Removes AP and AP Parry from the targeted enemy and applies the Mocked state on it.
Stacking is shared among Mockeries.

On a free cell: summons a Discouraging Fire.

primary.name: Pilfering
primary.description: Steals Range from the target and health in the Fire element from enemies.

variant.name: Distracting Word
variant.description:
Attracts targets towards the centre, heals allies and inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect.
The attraction does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Lifting Word
primary.description: Switches places with the targeted ally.

variant.name: Fountain of Youth
variant.description:
Heals allies and places an end-of-turn glyph that heals allies in an area of effect.
Makes the caster Unlockable as long as they are inside the glyph.

primary.name: Tribal Paintbrush
primary.description:
Paints the target and heals allies or inflicts Earth damage on enemies.

On a Painted target: spreads the Paint, heals allies and inflicts Earth damage on enemies in an area of effect.

On the caster: consumes all Paints to inflict Earth damage on all Painted enemies.
• The damage is increased for each enemy hit before applying the effects.
• Increases the caster's pushback damage for each ally hit.

variant.name: Shrill Choir
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies or heals allies.
The damage and healing are increased when a Mockery is applied by the caster or when one of their Will-o'-the-Wisps dies.

The effects can only be increased once per turn and decrease after the spell is used.

primary.name: Cryotherapy
primary.description:
Inflicts Water damage on enemies and applies the Cryotherapy state on the target:
• Applies a shield on the targeted ally or removes Dodge from enemies.
• Removes the spell's effects to heal allies and inflict Water damage on enemies in an area of effect if the target loses the state.

variant.name: Murmur
variant.description:
Inflicts Air damage on and steals MP from enemies.

On an ally: heals the target and increases its MP.

primary.name: Frightening Word
primary.description: Repels the target.

variant.name: Scalpel
variant.description: Reduces the duration of effects on the target, and inflicts damage on enemies or heals allies in the best element.

primary.name: Word of Recovery
primary.description: Completely heals the targeted ally but makes the ally Unhealable.

variant.name: Uniting Word
variant.description:
Transfers some of the targeted ally's health to all Encouraged allies.
A transfer from one of the caster's Fairies is greater.

On an Encouraged ally: transfers some of the health of all Encouraged allies to the target.

breeds.name: Iop
breeds.description: Iops are go-getting warriors beyond reproach! One thing's for sure: Iops know how to use their weapons. They need to jump in a brawl at least once a day just to feel alive. Their impetuousness can make Iops the best of knights, but also the worst!

primary.name: Chopper
primary.description: Inflicts Fire damage and removes MP in an area of effect.

variant.name: Accumulation
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage.

On the caster: increases spell damage.

primary.name: Intimidation
primary.description: Inflicts damage on enemies in the caster's best element and repels the target.

variant.name: Conquest
variant.description:
Summons a Iop Strategist that can reflect 50% of the damage he suffers in an area of effect around himself.
The damage reflection does not affect the caster.

The Iop Strategist reduces immediate allied damage by 50%.

There can only be one Iop Strategist per team. If the Iop Strategist is still on the field when summoned again, the old one is destroyed to make room for the new one.

primary.name: Jump
primary.description: Teleports the caster onto the targeted cell and increases damage received by enemies in an area of effect.

variant.name: Agitation
variant.description:
Increases the targeted ally's MP and makes them Unlockable.
Also increases their Power for each MP used.

primary.name: Fervour
primary.description: Applies a shield on the caster and their allies and inflicts Water damage on enemies in an area of effect.

variant.name: Threat
variant.description: Attracts the target and inflicts Water damage on enemies.

primary.name: Divine Sword
primary.description: Inflicts Air damage on enemies and increases the caster's and their allies' damage in an area of effect.

variant.name: Sword of Judgement
variant.description:
Applies a shield to the caster, inflicts Water damage and applies the Condemned state to the target:
• Inflicts greater delayed Water damage to the target.

The shield is greater and the delay is reset on a Condemned target.

On the caster: applies a shield.

primary.name: Destructive Sword
primary.description: Erodes the targets and inflicts Fire damage in an area of effect.

variant.name: Castigation
variant.description: Erodes the targets and inflicts Water damage in an area of effect.

primary.name: Endurance
primary.description:
Applies a shield on the caster and inflicts Water damage.
The damage does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Pygmachia
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage in an area of effect.
The spell damage is increased after each casting for the current turn.

The damage does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Breath
primary.description: Repels targets from the centre and inflicts Air damage on enemies in an area of effect.

variant.name: Gathering
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and attracts the targets up to the centre in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Concentration
primary.description:
Inflicts Earth damage.
The damage is greater on summons.

variant.name: Sentence
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage and applies the Sentence state on the target:
• At the end of the target's turn, inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect around the target.

The damage does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Fit of Rage
primary.description:
Inflicts Earth damage.
The spell's damage is increased after each casting. 

The bonuses decrement if the spell is not cast again.

variant.name: Iop's Wrath
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage.
The spell's damage increases when the spell is recovered.

primary.name: Friction
primary.description:
Attracts the target and applies the Friction state on the target:
• On an enemy: draws the target toward their enemy attacker.
• On an ally: draws their enemy attackers towards them.

variant.name: Fight Back
variant.description:
Repels the target and applies the Fight Back state on the target:
• On an enemy: repels the target if they attack the caster.
• On an ally: repels the enemy attackers.

primary.name: Grip
primary.description: Makes the targeted enemy Invulnerable and immobilises them.

variant.name: Duel
variant.description:
Makes the caster and the targeted enemy Invulnerable at long range, applies the Gravity state on them, and immobilises them.
The duration of the Gravity state is longer on the caster.

primary.name: Power
primary.description: Increases the target's Power and pushback damage.

variant.name: Prosecution
variant.description: Erodes the target.

primary.name: Virtue
primary.description:
Applies a shield around allies in an area of effect.
Also removes Power from the caster for each adjacent ally (stackable 4 times).

variant.name: Massacre
variant.description: Increases damage suffered by the targeted enemy and reflects part of the damage they suffer in an area of effect around them.

primary.name: Strengthstorm
primary.description:
Inflicts Fire damage.
Does not affect the caster.

Also inflicts Fire damage on the initial enemy if the spell is cast on another target.
The damage increases after 2 consecutive casts on the same enemy.

variant.name: Pounding
variant.description: Inflicts Air damage and removes MP in an area of effect.

primary.name: Celestial Sword
primary.description:
Inflicts Air damage in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Zenith
variant.description:
Inflicts Air damage in an area of effect. 
The second attack is based on the caster's remaining MP.

primary.name: Vitality
primary.description:
Increases the target's Vitality.
The Vitality is higher on the caster.

variant.name: Violence
variant.description: Repels targets in an area of effect.

primary.name: Sword of Iop
primary.description:
Inflicts Earth damage in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Cleaver
variant.description:
Applies a shield on the caster for each enemy in the area of effect and inflicts Water damage in an area of effect.
The damage does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Sword of Fate
primary.description:
Inflicts Fire damage.
The spell's damage increases when the spell is recovered.

variant.name: Tumult
variant.description:
Increases the spell's damage for each enemy in the area of effect and inflicts Fire damage in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Pressure
primary.description: Erodes the target and inflicts Earth Damage.

variant.name: Fracture
variant.description: Erodes the targets and inflicts Air damage in an area of effect.

primary.name: Outpouring
primary.description: Moves the caster closer to the target and inflicts Water damage on enemies.

variant.name: Destructive Ring
variant.description:
Inflicts Air damage on enemies and attracts targets towards the centre in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Precipitation
primary.description:
Increases the targeted ally's AP and applies the Hasty state on them, preventing the ally from using their weapon.
Removes unparryable AP from that ally on the following turn.

The state is not applied on the caster.

variant.name: Determination
variant.description: Makes the targeted ally Unmovable and applies a shield on them.

breeds.name: Cra
breeds.description: As proud as they are accurate, Cras are the master archers. They are precious allies to those embroiled in a messy attack. From a distance, their bows, eyes and tight fists become one as their deadly arrows pierce through the melee, giving their enemy no respite.

primary.name: Frozen Arrow
primary.description:
Removes AP and inflicts Water damage.
The spell's damage is increased after each casting (stackable 2 times).

variant.name: Plaguing Arrow
variant.description: Reduces the healing received by the target and applies a start-of-turn Air poison.

primary.name: Barricade Arrow
primary.description: Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and repels targets in an area of effect.

variant.name: Destructive Bolts
variant.description: Inflicts Earth damage and removes damage from enemies, and repels the targets in an area of effect.

primary.name: Lashing Arrow
primary.description: Removes MP and inflicts Air damage.

variant.name: Assailing Arrow
variant.description:
Applies effects based on the caster's position in relation to the target, inflicts Earth damage on enemies and increases the caster's Power:
• Repels the target if the caster is in close combat.
• Moves the caster closer to the target if the caster is at a distance.

primary.name: Vagabond Arrow
primary.description: Moves the caster away from the target and inflicts Earth damage on enemies.

variant.name: Evasive Arrow
variant.description: Moves the caster away from the target, repels it and inflicts Water damage on enemies.

primary.name: Sidestep
primary.description:
Teleports the caster to the targeted cell.
Increases the caster's MP on the following turn.

variant.name: Tactical Beacon
variant.description:
Summons a static Beacon that can:
• Attract targets in an area of effect if an ally inflicts ranged damage on it or pushes it.
• Pushes targets in an area of effect if an ally inflicts close-combat or pushback damage on it.

The Beacon reduces allied damage suffered and is destroyed 3 turns after being summoned.

Also increases the caster's Power for each enemy in the targeted cell's line of sight.

primary.name: Distant Shots
primary.description:
Increases the minimum and maximum range of all the caster's offensive Cra spells.
Also increases allies' Range (excluding Cras) in an area of effect around the caster and their Beacons.

variant.name: Piercing Shot
variant.description: Erodes the target and increases the damage it suffers until the next attack.

primary.name: Exploding Arrow
primary.description:
Removes Range, inflicts Fire damage and applies the Exploding Arrow state on the target:
• Applies the effects without the state to enemies in an area of effect around the target at the end of its turn.

The effects may be triggered prematurely if the target suffers pushback damage.

variant.name: Slow-Down Arrow
variant.description: Removes AP and MP and inflicts Water damage in an area of effect.

primary.name: Abolition Arrow
primary.description:
Steals HP in the Earth element in an area of effect.
The damage is greater on targets with shield points.

The size of the area of effect increases after each casting for the current turn.

variant.name: Persecuting Arrow
variant.description:
Steals HP in the Air element.
Also inflicts delayed Air damage if the target isn't in the caster's line of sight.

primary.name: Retreat Arrow
primary.description: Inflicts Air damage on enemies and repels the target.

variant.name: Radiant Arrow
variant.description: Steals HP in the Fire element from enemies and pushes targets outwards in an area of effect.

primary.name: Immobilising Arrow
primary.description:
Steals MP and inflicts Water damage.
The spell's damage is increased after each casting.

variant.name: Tyrannical Arrow
variant.description:
Inflicts damage and applies an end-of-turn Fire poison on the target.
The poison is regenerated if the target is moved under the effects of the spell.

Inflicts Fire damage prematurely and removes the spell's effects if the target suffers pushback damage.

primary.name: Powerful Shots
primary.description:
Increases the caster's Power, Pushback Damage and Critical.
Reduces Range and reduces the minimum Range of all their Cra spells on the following turn.

variant.name: Loving Arrows
variant.description:
Heals the targeted ally.

Also shares the damage between the initial allied fighter and another allied fighter, while increasing their Power, if the spell is cast on this other fighter.

Heals do not affect the caster.

primary.name: Dispersing Arrow
primary.description:
Inflicts Air damage on enemies and pushes targets back from the centre of the area of effect.
The pushback is greater at the edge of the area.

variant.name: Burning Arrows
variant.description: Moves the caster away from the targets, inflicts Fire damage on enemies and repels targets in an area of effect.

primary.name: Explosive Arrow
primary.description: Inflicts Fire damage in an area of effect.

variant.name: Slaughtering Arrow
variant.description: Increases the spell's damage for each entity in the area of effect and inflicts Earth damage in an area of effect.

primary.name: Bat's Eye
primary.description: Reveals invisible entities, removes Range and steals HP in the Water element in an area of effect.

variant.name: Raining Arrows
variant.description:
Removes MP Parry and inflicts Air damage in an area of effect.
The area-of-effect damage does not decrease with distance.
Does not affect the caster.

The effects are cast again from the targeted cell on the following turn.

primary.name: Eye for Eye
primary.description:
Steals HP in the Earth element in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

The spell's damage increases for each enemy attack suffered on the previous turn.

variant.name: Paralysing Arrow
variant.description: Removes AP and MP and inflicts Water damage in an area of effect.

primary.name: Survival Beacon
primary.description:
