Summons a beacon that can heal all allies in its line of sight at the start of its turn.
It can also switch positions with the caster if the caster attacks while being in its line of sight.

The beacon is destroyed 2 turns after being summoned.

variant.name: Reprisal
variant.description: Applies the Gravity state on targets and inflicts Neutral damage on enemies based on their eroded health in an area of effect.

primary.name: Withdrawal Shot
primary.description:
Moves the caster away from the targeted enemy or moves the caster closer to the targeted ally.
Also increases the caster's Range.

variant.name: Vendetta
variant.description: Places a single-cell trap that inflicts damage in the caster's best element on enemies, increases the damage they suffer and attracts entities towards its centre in an area of effect.

primary.name: Punitive Arrow
primary.description:
Erodes the target and inflicts Earth damage.
The spell's damage increases the next time it is cast.

variant.name: Arrow of Judgement
variant.description:
Removes Power and inflicts Earth damage.
The first attack is based on the caster's remaining MP.

primary.name: Atonement Arrow
primary.description:
Reduces healing received by the target and inflicts Water damage.
The spell's damage increases for subsequent castings.

variant.name: Redemption Arrow
variant.description:
Steals HP in the Water element.
The spell's damage is increased every time an attempted AP or MP removal is successful.

Damage is reset after the spell is used.

primary.name: Piercing Arrow
primary.description:
Inflicts Air damage on enemies and repels targets in an area of effect.
The area-of-effect damage does not decrease with distance and is greater on targets with shield points.

variant.name: Boomerang Arrow
variant.description:
Removes MP and inflicts Air damage.
Does not affect the caster.

Removes MP and steals HP from the initial target and from enemies between the initial target and the new target if they are in line with each other.
Also affects Beacons.
Applies these effects between the last target and the caster at the end of the caster's turn if they are in line with each other.

primary.name: Devouring Arrow
primary.description:
Steals HP in the Fire element.
Does not affect the caster.
The health steal increases after each casting on the same enemy.

Also inflicts Fire damage on the initial enemy if the spell is cast on another target, or delayed damage if the spell is not recast.
The damage increases based on the number of castings on the same enemy.

variant.name: Fulminating Arrow
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage.
Rebounds on the nearest enemy in a 2-cell circle.
Can also rebound on beacons.

The spell's damage increases with each target hit.

primary.name: Absolute Acuteness
primary.description:
Increases the minimum range of all the caster's offensive Cra spells to deactivate line of sight on all their spells.
Also increases their Critical.

variant.name: Sentinel
variant.description:
Increases the caster's ranged damage and Range.
Also reveals invisible entities in an area of effect in the caster's and their Beacons' line of sight.

The effects are reduced for each MP used.

breeds.name: Sadida
breeds.description: Sadidas are summoners who poison the lives of their enemies! Taming brambles to form horrifying weapons, crafting war and healing dolls – these are a Sadida's bread and butter.

primary.name: Madoll
primary.description:
Replaces a Tree with a biddable Doll that can Infect and apply a start-of-turn Air poison.

Upon its death, the Doll becomes a Tree again.
If it was summoned from a Leafy Tree, the Tree it turns into upon dying will again be Leafy.

variant.name: Transmuted Madoll
variant.description:
Summons a biddable Doll that can Infect and apply a start-of-turn Air poison.

The Doll is replaced by a Tree 3 turns after being summoned.

primary.name: Tree
primary.description:
Plants a Tree.
A Tree becomes Leafy after 1 turn.

There can only be 6 Trees per team. Planting a seventh Tree will cause the first one to die.

variant.name: Leafy Tree
variant.description:
Plants a Leafy Tree.
All Trees summoned by the caster immediately turn into Leafy Trees.

There can only be 6 Trees per team. Planting a seventh Tree will cause the first one to die.

primary.name: Bramble
primary.description:
Infects the target and inflicts Earth damage.

On a Leafy Tree: applies the effects on enemies in a 2-cell circle.

On an enemy: also applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

variant.name: Insolent Bramble
variant.description:
Reduces the duration of effects on the target and inflicts Earth damage on enemies.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

primary.name: Bane
primary.description:
Steals HP in the Water element.

On a Doll: applies the effects on enemies in a 1-cell square.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

variant.name: Haunted Forest
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage on enemies and applies the Haunted Forest state on them in an area of effect:
• Infects the target if it attacks one of the caster's Trees.

The area of effect extends in a 1-cell square around Leafy Trees, and the effects are only applied once each time it is cast.

primary.name: The Block
primary.description:
Replaces a Tree with a biddable Doll that can switch places if bidden and can block enemies.
It can also increase its MP and make itself Unlockable.

Upon its death, the Doll becomes a Tree again.
If it was summoned from a Leafy Tree, the Tree it turns into upon dying will again be Leafy.

variant.name: Transmuted Block
variant.description:
Summons a biddable Doll that can switch places if bidden and can block enemies.
It can also increase its MP and make itself Unlockable.

The Doll is replaced by a Tree 3 turns after being summoned.

primary.name: Sadida's Tear
primary.description:
Heals allies or inflicts Water damage on enemies.

On a Tree: applies the effects in a 2-cell circle and transforms the Tree into a Leafy Tree.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

variant.name: Rise of Sap
variant.description:
Steals HP in the Water element from enemies and heals allies (except the caster) based on the damage inflicted in an area of effect.

On Trees: also transforms them into Leafy Trees.

primary.name: Paralysing Sap
primary.description: Infects the target, removes MP Parry from it and applies an end-of-turn Fire poison on it.

variant.name: Miasmas
variant.description:
Infects and applies an end-of-turn Air poison on enemies in an area of effect.
The area of effect extends around Leafy Trees and Dolls.

primary.name: Soothing Bramble
primary.description:
Heals allies or removes MP from enemies.

On a Leafy Tree: applies the effects in a 2-cell circle.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

variant.name: Repotting
variant.description: Heals a Sadida summons, teleports it to the first available cell between it and the caster, and plants a Tree on the targeted cell.

primary.name: Sylvan Power
primary.description:
Replaces a Leafy Tree with a controllable Leafy Tree that can:
• Infect and push a target.
• Heal allies and reduce healing received by enemies in an area of effect.
• Shorten the length of effects on a target.

The controllable Tree is replaced by a Leafy Tree 2 turns after being summoned.

variant.name: Vegetal Influence
variant.description:
Replaces a Leafy Tree with a controllable Leafy Tree that can:
• Infect and attract a target.
• Apply a shield around allies and remove MP from enemies in an area of effect.
• Plant Unmovable Brambles.

The controllable Tree is replaced by a Leafy Tree 2 turns after being summoned.

primary.name: Sacrificial Doll
primary.description:
Replaces a Tree with a biddable Doll that can sacrifice itself to Infect and inflict Water damage in an area of effect.
Its Vitality and final damage increase with each turn.

Upon its death, the Doll becomes a Tree again.
If it was summoned from a Leafy Tree, the Tree it turns into upon dying will again be Leafy.

variant.name: Transmuted Sacrificial Doll
variant.description:
Summons a biddable Doll that can sacrifice itself to Infect and inflict Water damage in an area of effect.
Its Vitality and final damage increase with each turn.

The Doll is replaced by a Tree 3 turns after being summoned.

primary.name: Earthquake
primary.description:
In an area of effect around the caster, a Leafy Tree or a Doll:
• Inflicts Earth damage on enemies.
• Attracts entities towards the centre of the area of effect.
• Reveals invisible entities.

variant.name: Mandrake
variant.description:
Inflicts Air damage and applies the Mandrake state on the targeted enemy:
• Infects the target if it suffers damage from a poison or summons.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

primary.name: Natural Gift
primary.description:
Sacrifices a Leafy Tree or a Doll to share the damage among allies and heal them in an area of effect.
Damage sharing does not affect static summons.

variant.name: Harmony
variant.description: Roots the caster and shares damage between all their Trees and the caster.

primary.name: Voodoo Sacrifice
primary.description:
Inflicts Water damage.
The damage is greater on summons.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

On a Doll:
• Sacrifices the Doll to heal allies, apply the effects on enemies and Infect them in an area of effect.
• Resets its cooldown period.

variant.name: Ardent Thistles
variant.description:
Inflicts the Ardent Thistles state on the targeted enemy:
• Applies an end-of-turn Fire poison on the target for each MP it uses (stackable 3 times).

On an enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

primary.name: Contagion
primary.description:
Inflicts Air damage and removes MP. 

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies and spreads the Infection in an area of effect around the target.

variant.name: Mangrove
variant.description:
Heals allies and inflicts Water damage on and removes MP from enemies in an area of effect.
The area of effect extends around Trees, and the effects are applied only once per casting.

Also transforms all Trees into Leafy Trees.

primary.name: Inoculation
primary.description:
Increases the spell's damage for each Infected enemy and inflicts Air damage.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

Consumes all Infections around the target.

variant.name: Force of Nature
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage.
Spell damage is increased for each of the caster's Leafy Trees that has been planted.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

primary.name: Inflatable Doll
primary.description:
Replaces a Tree with a biddable Doll that can heal, inflict Fire damage and repel.

Upon its death, the Doll becomes a Tree again.
If it was summoned from a Leafy Tree, the Tree it turns into upon dying will again be Leafy.

variant.name: Transmuted Inflatable
variant.description:
Summons a biddable Doll that can heal, inflict Fire damage and repel.

The Doll is replaced by a Tree 3 turns after being summoned.

primary.name: Aggressive Bramble
primary.description:
Steals MP and inflicts Earth damage.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

variant.name: Charred Charms
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage and applies the Charred Charms state on the targeted enemy:
• Part of the damage suffered by the caster's Trees is reflected back onto the target.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

primary.name: Tree of Life
primary.description:
Plants a Tree of Life.
The Tree of Life turns back into a Leafy Tree 2 turns after being summoned.

variant.name: Vegetal Altruism
variant.description: Sacrifices a Leafy Tree or a Doll to increase Dolls' Vitality and heal the caster.

primary.name: Burning Bush
primary.description:
Inflicts Fire damage and reduces MP.

On a Leafy Tree: applies the effects on enemies in a 2-cell circle.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

variant.name: Bush Fire
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on and removes MP from enemies, and applies the Bush Fire state on Trees and enemies in an area of effect:
• At the end of the target's turn, inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect around the target.
• Can inflict damage on Trees.

primary.name: Hemlock
primary.description:
Inflicts Air damage.

On a Leafy Tree: applies the effects and maintains the Infection on enemies in a 2-cell circle.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies and maintains the Infection on the target.

variant.name: Poisoned Wind
variant.description: Infects the target and applies a start-of-turn Air poison.

primary.name: Wild Grass
primary.description: Inflicts Fire damage and removes MP from enemies in an area of effect.

variant.name: Voodoo Curse
variant.description:
Inflicts Water damage and applies the Voodoo state on the targeted enemy:
• Inflicts Water damage on the target when one of the caster's Dolls dies.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

primary.name: The Ultra-Powerful
primary.description:
Replaces a Tree with a biddable Doll that can inflict Earth damage, remove MP or give MP.
It can also summon another biddable Doll that can steal or give Range.

Upon its death, the Doll becomes a Tree again.
If it was summoned from a Leafy Tree, the Tree it turns into upon dying will again be Leafy.

variant.name: Transmuted Ultra-Powerful
variant.description:
Summons a biddable Doll that can inflict Earth damage, remove MP or give MP.
It can also summon another biddable Doll that can steal or give Range.

The Doll is replaced by a Tree 3 turns after being summoned.

breeds.name: Sacrier
breeds.description: Sacriers are berserkers whose powers increase with each hit! As they have nothing to fear from cuts or blows, they haunt the front lines in battle, ready to draw first blood! Sacriers are the perfect allies for those long, relentless battles.

primary.name: Mutilation
primary.description:
Sacrifices some of the caster's health to increase their Power.
At the start of each turn, sacrifices some of their health again to increment their Mutilation state as long as the spell is active.

Casting the spell again removes the applied effects and casts the Coagulation spell:
• Applies a shield on the caster.
• The shield is greater based on the Mutilation state.

variant.name: Blood Pact
variant.description: Increases the caster's Vitality and Power.

primary.name: Voracious Sword
primary.description: Summons a biddable Voracious Sword that can steal HP in the Neutral element.

variant.name: Dancing Sword
variant.description: Summons a biddable Dancing Sword that can attract, switch positions, and inflict Neutral damage.

primary.name: Ravages
primary.description: Moves the caster closer to the target and inflicts Earth damage on enemies.

variant.name: Light Speed
variant.description: Teleports the caster to the first available cell between them and the target and inflicts Air damage on enemies in an area of effect.

primary.name: Assault
primary.description: Switches places with the target and inflicts Air damage on enemies.

variant.name: Aversion
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and repels targets from the centre in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Transposition
primary.description:
Switches places with the target.

The spell's maximum range is increased by 4 if the caster is at Suffering 6 or more.

variant.name: Fluctuation
variant.description:
Makes the caster and their Swords Unlockable and increases their MP.

The effects are greater if the caster is at Suffering 6 or more.

primary.name: Condensation
primary.description: Inflicts Water damage on enemies and attracts the targets towards the caster in an area of effect.

variant.name: Influx
variant.description: Attracts targets towards the centre and inflicts Earth damage on enemies in an area of effect.

primary.name: Hostility
primary.description: Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and repels the target.

variant.name: Projection
variant.description: Teleports the caster symmetrically in relation to the target and inflicts Water damage on enemies.

primary.name: Thorn Crown
primary.description:
Applies the Gravity state on targets in an area of effect, a shield and the Thorn Crown state on the caster:
• Reflects the damage suffered in close combat back at adjacent enemies.

Applies an additional shield on the caster for each enemy in the area of effect if the caster is at Suffering 6 or more.

variant.name: Pillory
variant.description:
Applies a shield on the targeted ally and applies the Unmovable and Pillory states on the target:
• Removes the spell's effects and heals the caster if the target suffers close-combat damage.

The effects cannot be removed if the caster is at Suffering 6 or more.

primary.name: Transfusion
primary.description: Inflicts Neutral damage on enemies based on the caster's remaining health and transfers some of the caster's HP to allies in an area of effect.

variant.name: Blood Ties
variant.description:
Moves the caster closer to the target and applies the Blood Ties state on the targeted enemy:
• Moves the caster closer to the targeted enemy if the caster suffers enemy damage.

The immediate movement is greater and the spell's maximum range is increased by 4 if the caster is at Suffering 6 or more.

primary.name: Slaughter
primary.description:
Lowers the healing received by the targets and steals HP in the Fire element in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Gash
variant.description: Sacrifices some of the caster's health to inflict Earth damage.

primary.name: Blood Bath
primary.description: Increases the caster's Lock for each entity in the area of effect and steals health in the Earth element in an area of effect.

variant.name: Immolation
variant.description:
Sacrifices some of the caster's health to inflict Fire damage in an area of effect.
The damage does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Sacrifice
primary.description:
Intercepts damage suffered by allies in an area of effect.
Also destroys the caster's Swords in the area of effect to transfer some of their remaining health to the caster.

variant.name: Penitence
variant.description:
Switches places with the target and applies the Penitence state to it:
• On an ally: switches the target's and the caster's positions if the target suffers damage.
• On an enemy: switches the target's and the caster's positions if the caster suffers damage.
• On the caster: switches places with the caster's attackers.

primary.name: Desolation
primary.description: Steals health in the Air element and removes MP in an area of effect.

variant.name: Clobbering
variant.description:
Sacrifices some of the caster's health to inflict Water damage in an area of effect.
The damage does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Dissolution
primary.description:
Steals HP in the Water element and removes Dodge in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Carnage
variant.description: Sacrifices some of the caster's health to inflict Air damage in an area of effect.

primary.name: Libation
primary.description:
Sacrifices some of the caster's health to reduce the effect duration and heals them at the end of their next turn.
The healing increases based on the amount of Suffering.

variant.name: Punishment
variant.description: Inflicts Neutral damage on enemies in an area of effect based on the caster's remaining health, while sacrificing some of the caster's health.

primary.name: Berserk
primary.description:
Sacrifices some of the caster's health to apply the Berserk state on them:
• Makes the caster Unlockable.
• Increases their spell damage.
• Reduces the healing received by the caster.

The Berserk state is removed if the caster returns to Suffering 5 or less or recasts the spell.

variant.name: Jashin Ritual
variant.description:
Applies the Jashin Ritual state on the targeted enemy and places a glyph-aura under the caster that applies the state to the caster and makes the caster Unlockable.
As long as the caster and the target are in this state, reflects damage suffered by the caster onto the target and vice versa.

primary.name: Absorption
primary.description: Steals health in the Fire element and removes Power from enemies or transfers part of the caster's health to the targeted ally.

variant.name: Fury
variant.description:
Inflicts Air damage in an area of effect and increases the caster's final damage.
The damage does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Torture
primary.description:
Steals HP in the Earth element.
Entities who attack the target are healed by some of the damage inflicted.

variant.name: Nervousness
variant.description:
Inflicts Water damage in an area of effect and increases the caster's Critical odds.
The damage does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Stase
primary.description: Steals HP on the Water element and reduces Critical odds.

variant.name: Excruciating Pain
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage in an area of effect and increases the caster's Power.
The damage does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Attraction
primary.description:
Attracts the target.

The attraction is greater and the spell's maximum range is increased by 4 if the caster is at Suffering 6 or more.

variant.name: Perfusion
variant.description:
Transfers some of the caster's health to their allies in an area of effect and applies the Perfusion state on them:
• Allies in the Perfusion state are healed by some of the damage inflicted on the caster.

The transfer is not applied if the caster is at Suffering 6 or more.

primary.name: Retribution
primary.description: Inflicts damage in the caster's best element and Neutral damage based on their eroded health.

variant.name: Bloodthirsty Madness
variant.description:
Steals health in the caster's best element in an area of effect.
The area-of-effect damage does not decrease with distance.

primary.name: Hemorrhage
primary.description: Reduces healing received by the target and steals health in the Air element.

variant.name: Decimation
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage and increases damage suffered by targets in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

breeds.name: Pandawa
breeds.description: Pandawas are warriors versed in martial arts who know what they can get out of their bodies! And out of the bodies of others... Indeed, Pandawas can always get crowds moving: they don't hesitate to carry their allies on their shoulders to protect them, and as for their enemies, they'll send them hurtling before celebrating their victory with a big draught of bamboo milk!

primary.name: Explosive Palm
primary.description:
Inflicts Fire damage.
Does not affect the caster.

Modifies the spell based on the caster's state after it is cast:
• The spell's AP cost increases after the first time it is cast.
• Sober: the damage is applied in an area of effect.
• Drunk: the spell's damage increases.

Each effect can be stacked one time.

variant.name: Distillation
variant.description:
Inflicts damage and applies a start-of-turn Water poison on targets in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

The spell's and poison's damage increase each time the spell's poisons are triggered on a target (stackable 4 times).

Bonuses are removed after the spell has been used.

primary.name: Hangover
primary.description:
Makes the caster Sober and inflicts Earth damage.
The damage is greater if the caster left the Drunk state during the current turn.

variant.name: Fiery Breath
variant.description: Inflicts Fire damage and reduces Critical odds in an area of effect.

primary.name: Blow-Out
primary.description:
Makes the caster Drunk or Sober.
Gives 1 AP back if the caster gets Sober.

variant.name: Boozer
variant.description:
Makes the caster Drunk or Sober.
Increases the caster's MP if they become Sober.

primary.name: Terror
primary.description:
Repels the target and applies effects on the target based on the caster's state:
• Sober: the pushback is greater.
• Drunk: reduces Critical odds.

variant.name: Consolation
variant.description: Attracts and heals the targeted ally.

primary.name: Schnaps
primary.description:
Inflicts Air damage and applies effects on the targets in an area of effect based on the caster's state:
• Sober: removes AP and MP Reduction.
• Drunk: reduces Pushback Resistance.

Does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Debauchery
variant.description:
Applies effects based on the caster's state and inflicts Earth damage:
• Sober: makes the caster Drunk.
• Drunk: removes Dodge from the target.

primary.name: Karcham
primary.description:
Carries or throws the target.

The spell's maximum range increases when the caster is carrying a target.

variant.name: Chamrak
variant.description:
Carries or throws the target.

The spell's maximum range is increased, and the line of sight is disabled when the caster is carrying a target.

primary.name: Melancholy
primary.description:
Inflicts Water damage on enemies and repels the targets in an area of effect.
The pushback is only applied if the caster is Sober.

If the caster is Drunk, the spell's range is halved but it inflicts greater damage.

variant.name: Pandjiu
variant.description: Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and attracts the target.

primary.name: Eviction
primary.description:
Applies effects based on the caster's state and inflicts Earth damage on enemies.
• Sober: teleports the caster symmetrically in relation to the target.
• Drunk: teleports the target symmetrically in relation to the caster and inflicts damage in an area of effect.

variant.name: Alcoholic Breath
variant.description:
Inflicts Air damage on enemies and repels targets in an area of effect.

If the caster is Drunk, the spell's range is halved but it inflicts greater damage.

primary.name: Inebriation
primary.description:
Summons a Barrel that increases its summoner's Power when carried and makes the summoner Drunk when thrown.
The caster also inflicts damage in their best element on enemies in an area of effect around the point of impact.

Gives 1 AP back to the caster if carrying the Barrel.

If the caster's Barrel is still on the field when the spell is recast, the old one is destroyed and replaced by a new one.

variant.name: Drunkenness
variant.description:
Summons a Barrel that heals the summoner when carried and makes the summoner Drunk when thrown.
The caster also heals all allies in an area of effect around the point of impact.

Gives 1 AP back to the caster if carrying the Barrel.

If the caster's Barrel is still on the field when the spell is recast, the old one is destroyed and replaced by a new one.

primary.name: Stabilisation
primary.description: Roots the target and increases the targeted ally's MP Parry.

variant.name: Sherpa
variant.description:
Increases the number of casts per turn and per target for the caster's Karcham and Chamrak spells.
Also makes the targeted ally Unlockable.

primary.name: Spirit Bond
primary.description:
Summons a biddable Pandawasta that removes Dodge, Power and Lock from opponents.
It can also increase its characteristics during combat or carry the Sober caster if the caster attacks it in close combat.

The Pandawasta reduces immediate allied damage by 50%.

variant.name: Bamboo
variant.description:
Summons a Bamboo that acts as an obstacle.
It can carry the Sober caster if the caster attacks it in close combat.

The Bamboo reduces immediate allied damage by 80%.

Gives 1 AP back to the caster if carrying a Bamboo.

primary.name: Tipple
primary.description:
Inflicts Water damage and applies effects based on the caster's state:
• Sober: increases the caster's Range.
• Drunk: removes Range from the target.

variant.name: Numbness
variant.description:
Inflicts Air damage and applies effects based on the caster's state in an area of effect:
• Sober: increases the caster's MP for each entity hit (stackable 3 times).
• Drunk: removes MP from targets.

The damage does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Brandy
primary.description:
Throws the target, heals allies and inflicts Water damage on enemies in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Filthipint
variant.description: Makes the caster Drunk and steals HP in the Earth element in an area of effect.

primary.name: Stain
primary.description: Reduces the duration of effects on the target and the Power of enemies.

variant.name: Brewing
variant.description:
Applies effects on the target based on the caster's state:
• Sober: increases the damage suffered by the target.
• Drunk: applies the Gravity state to the target and the Brewing state to the caster.

The Brewing state prevents the spell from being used in the Drunk state.
The spell's range is modifiable in the Sober state, but it is halved if the caster is Drunk.

primary.name: Fermentation
primary.description: Applies a shield on the targeted ally immediately and on the next turn.

variant.name: Bamboo Grove
variant.description:
Summons multiple Little Bamboos in an area of effect.

The Bamboos die at the start of the caster's next turn.

primary.name: Propulsion
primary.description:
Throws the target, heals allies, inflicts Air damage on enemies and repels targets from the centre in an area of effect.
Heals do not affect the caster.

variant.name: Absinthe
variant.description: Makes the caster Drunk and steals HP in the Fire element.

primary.name: Stretcher
primary.description: Throws the target, attracts targets and moves the caster closer to the target, heals allies and inflicts Earth damage on enemies in an area of effect.

variant.name: Alcoshu
variant.description: Makes the caster Drunk and steals HP in the Water element.

primary.name: Pandilongation
primary.description: Throws the target, attracts targets towards the centre, heals allies and inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect.

variant.name: Liqueur
variant.description: Makes the caster Drunk and steals HP in the Air element.

primary.name: Nausea
primary.description:
Applies effects based on the caster's state and inflicts Air damage on enemies:
• Sober: moves the caster away from the target.
• Drunk: pushes the target back.

variant.name: Waterfall
variant.description: Throws the target, heals allies, inflicts Water damage on enemies and repels entities in an area of effect.

primary.name: Bamboo Milk
primary.description: Reduces the duration of effects on the caster and makes them Sober.

variant.name: Prohibition
variant.description:
Makes the target Invulnerable in Close Combat and Unhealable.

On the caster:
• Makes them Invulnerable in Close Combat and Sober.
• Applies the Prohibition state, which prevents them from entering the Drunk state and prevents Barrels' effects from applying to them.
• Makes them Unhealable at the start of the next turn.

primary.name: Explosive Flask
primary.description:
Inflicts Fire damage in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

If the caster is Drunk, the spell's range is halved but it inflicts greater damage.

variant.name: Pandatak
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage in an area of effect.

If the caster is Drunk, the spell's range is halved but it inflicts greater damage.

primary.name: Pandiniuras
primary.description: Increases the target's MP.

variant.name: Pandawa's Hand
variant.description:
Removes Power, inflicts damage based on the caster's state and applies the Pandawa's Hand state to the caster:
• Sober: inflicts damage in the caster's best element.
• Drunk: inflicts Neutral, Earth, Fire, Water and Air damage.

breeds.name: Rogue
breeds.description: Members of a clan originally created by Raval and the Smisse family, the Rogues have finally pledged allegiance to the god Eugor, who is none other than Sram. Masters of dirty tricks, backstabbing, time bombs and guns... the rogues only feel at home on dangerous grounds.

primary.name: Detonator
primary.description:
Adds 1 Combo to one of the caster's Bombs and makes it explode.
Gives 1 AP back to the caster before the explosion.

variant.name: Fuze
variant.description:
Makes one of the caster's Bombs explode.
Gives 3 AP back to the caster before the explosion.

primary.name: Explobomb
primary.description:
Places a Bomb that can inflict Fire damage in an area of effect when it explodes.

On a target: applies the Bomb's effects in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.
If the target is one of their Bombs: also adds 1 Combo to the Bomb and makes it explode.

The spell's AP cost increases by 1 for each of the caster's Explobombs present on the field.

variant.name: Resilient Explobomb
variant.description:
Places a Bomb that can inflict Fire damage in an area of effect when it explodes.

On a target: applies the Bomb's effects in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.
If the target is one of their Bombs: also adds 1 Combo to the Bomb and makes it explode.

primary.name: Grenado
primary.description:
Places a Bomb that can inflict Air damage and remove MP depending on its Combo in an area of effect when it explodes.
• Combo I to IV: -1 MP
• Combo V to IX: -2 MP
• Combo X to XV: -3 MP
• Wall of Air: -2 MP

On a target: applies the Bomb's effects in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.
If the target is one of their Bombs: also adds 1 Combo to the Bomb and makes it explode.

The spell's AP cost increases by 1 for each of the caster's Grenados present on the field.

variant.name: Resilient Grenado
variant.description:
Places a Bomb that can inflict Air damage and remove MP depending on its Combo in an area of effect when it explodes.
• Combo I to IV: -1 MP
• Combo V to IX: -2 MP
• Combo X to XV: -3 MP
• Wall of Air: -2 MP

On a target: applies the Bomb's effects in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.
If the target is one of their Bombs: also adds 1 Combo to the Bomb and makes it explode.

primary.name: Kickback
primary.description:
Applies a shield on the caster's Bombs and pushes them out from the centre in an area of effect.
The closer the spell is cast to one of the caster's Bombs, the more it is pushed.

Pushes other entities one cell only.
Does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Ruse
variant.description:
Moves the caster closer to the target.
If the target is one of the caster's Bombs, also applies a shield.

primary.name: Extraction
primary.description:
Steals HP in the Fire element.
The health steal is reduced by half on allies.

variant.name: Cadence
variant.description:
Inflicts Air damage on enemies in an area of effect.
Also reduces enemies' MP in an area of effect around the caster's Bombs in the area of effect.

primary.name: Magnet
primary.description:
Draws the caster's Bombs toward the centre and adds 1 Combo to them in an area of effect.
The Combo is only applied once per Bomb per turn and only if the Bombs are moved.

Attracts other entities one cell only.
Does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Crossing
variant.description:
Draws the caster's Bombs to the centre and adds 1 Combo to them in an area of effect.

The Combo is only applied once per Bomb per turn and only if the Bombs are moved.

primary.name: Carbine
primary.description: Inflicts Air damage on enemies and repels targets outwards in an area of effect.

variant.name: Obliteration
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage.
Damage increases with each Seismobomb or Sticky Bomb explosion.

On one of the caster's Bombs: adds Combos for each Seismobomb or Sticky Bomb explosion.

The effects are removed after the spell has been used.

primary.name: Dirty Trick
primary.description:
Adds 1 Combo to one of the caster's Bombs, switches positions with it and applies the Gravity to it.
The effects are only applied if the position switch can occur.

On an ally: only switches places with the target.

variant.name: Walking Bomb
variant.description:
Summons a controllable Bomb that can copy the element and some of the Combo of a caster's Bomb.

It is destroyed at the end of its second turn if it has not obtained an element.

primary.name: Water Bomb
primary.description:
Places a Bomb that can inflict Water damage and remove AP depending on its Combo in an area of effect when it explodes.
• Combo I to IV: -0 AP
• Combo V to IX: -1 AP
• Combo X to XV: -2 AP

On a target: applies the Bomb's effects in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.
If the target is one of their Bombs: also adds 1 Combo to the Bomb and makes it explode.

The wall of Water Bombs only removes AP from entities that move through it or start their turn inside it.
• Wall of Water: -2 AP

The spell's AP cost increases by 1 for each of the caster's Water Bombs present on the field.

variant.name: Resilient Water Bomb
variant.description:
Places a Bomb that can inflict Water damage and remove AP depending on its Combo in an area of effect when it explodes.
• Combo I to IV: -0 AP
• Combo V to IX: -1 AP
• Combo X to XV: -2 AP

On a target: applies the Bomb's effects in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.
If the target is one of their Bombs: also adds 1 Combo to the Bomb and makes it explode.

The wall of Water Bombs only removes AP from entities that move through it or start their turn inside it.
• Wall of Water: -2 AP

primary.name: Boombot
primary.description:
Summons a controllable robot that can move or trigger the caster's Bombs.
The robot is destroyed at the end of its turn.

variant.name: Megabomb
variant.description:
Summons a controllable Megabomb that can inflict Neutral Damage and devour Bombs to increase its damage.

When destroyed, it adds 1 Combo to the caster's Bombs, causes them to explode, and explodes in a 2-cell circle.

primary.name: Bombard
primary.description: Inflicts Earth damage on enemies and repels the targets in an area of effect.

variant.name: Machine Gun
variant.description: Inflicts Air damage and removes MP.

primary.name: Stolen Goods
primary.description: Inflicts Water damage on enemies and attracts the target.

variant.name: Weigh Down
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies.

On one of the caster's elemental Bombs: inflicts Fire damage on enemies between two elemental Bombs in the same row and adds 1 Combo to these Bombs.

The Combo is only applied once per Bomb per turn.

primary.name: Roguery
primary.description:
Applies a shield on all the caster's Bombs.

Creates the caster's illusions and teleports the caster to the targeted cell.
Ends the caster's current turn.

variant.name: Strategy
variant.description:
Teleports one of the caster's Bombs to its previous position and applies a shield to it.
The shield is only applied if the teleportation can occur.

primary.name: Pulsar
primary.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and repels targets outwards in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Shrapnel
variant.description:
Inflicts Water damage on enemies in an area of effect.
Also reduces enemies' AP in an area of effect around the caster's Bombs in the area of effect.

primary.name: Remission
primary.description:
Applies the Remission state on the target:
• Repels attackers if the target suffers close-combat damage.

If cast on one of the caster's Bombs: reduces long-range damage suffered.

variant.name: Bunker
variant.description:
Makes one of the caster's bombs Invulnerable and adds 1 Combo to it.

The effects are transferred to the Bomb produced by a Walking Bomb.

primary.name: Boomerang Daggers
primary.description: Erodes the targets and inflicts Air damage in an area of effect.

variant.name: Blunderbuss
variant.description: Erodes the targets and inflicts Water damage in an area of effect.

primary.name: Powder
primary.description:
Makes one of the caster's Bombs Unmovable.
Adds 2 Combos to the Bomb:
• By causing it to explode if it is destroyed.
• By removing the spell's effects if it is cast on another Bomb.

The effects are removed if the Bomb is triggered by an explosion effect.

variant.name: Sticky Bomb
variant.description:
Places a sticky bomb on the target.

On a free cell: places a trap that puts a Sticky Bomb on the entity that triggers it or makes one of the caster's Bombs explode.

The Bomb may be activated by activation spells or bomb explosions.
When activated, it inflicts damage in the caster's best element and makes the caster's Bombs explode in an area of effect.

A Sticky Bomb cannot be applied to an Elemental Bomb.

primary.name: Kaboom
primary.description:
Applies the Kaboom state to allies in an area of effect.

On the caster's Elemental Bombs: adds 1 Combo.

variant.name: Imposture
variant.description:
Switches places with the target and applies the Kaboom state to the caster.
• On an ally: also applies the state to them.
• On one of the caster's Elemental Bombs: adds 1 Combo to the Bomb.
Also applies the Imposture state on the caster and the targeted ally, which prevents the Kaboom state from being applied.

The Combo and the Kaboom state are only applied if the position switch can occur.

primary.name: Last Breath
primary.description: Reduces the caster's maximum Vitality to temporarily add 3 Combos to their Bombs.

variant.name: Magnetic Trap
variant.description: Places a single-cell trap that attracts entities, adds 1 Combo to the caster's Bombs and makes them explode in an area of effect.

primary.name: Musket
primary.description:
Inflicts Earth damage on enemies in an area of effect.
Also adds 1 Combo to the caster's Bombs in an area of effect.

The Combo is only applied once per Bomb per turn.

variant.name: Shot Pellets
variant.description:
Steals HP in the Fire element in an area of effect.
The health steal is reduced by half on allies.

Does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Deception
primary.description:
Inflicts Water damage and removes AP in the area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

On the caster's Bombs: teleports them symmetrically in relation to the centre of the area of effect.

variant.name: Arquebus
variant.description: Reduces the duration of effects on the target and inflicts Earth damage on enemies.

primary.name: Seismobomb
primary.description:
Places a Bomb that can inflict Earth damage in an area of effect when it explodes.

On a target: applies the Bomb's effects in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.
If the target is one of their Bombs: also adds 1 Combo to the Bomb and makes it explode.

The spell's AP cost increases by 1 for each of the caster's Seismobombs present on the field.

variant.name: Resilient Seismobomb
variant.description:
Places a Bomb that can inflict Earth damage in an area of effect when it explodes.

On a target: applies the Bomb's effects in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.
If the target is one of their Bombs: also adds 1 Combo to the Bomb and makes it explode.

breeds.name: Masqueraider
breeds.description: Masqueraiders wear magic masks which enable them to change face more often than they change their shirts. Turn after turn, they're either sticking like glue, enraged psychopaths or firm fans of strategic retreat. They can quickly adapt to any situation, but watch out for their moodswings! Legend has it, these unpredictable beings are blessed by Sadida himself.

primary.name: Boliche
primary.description: Moves the caster closer to the target, inflicts Water damage on enemies, and repels the target.

variant.name: Ronda
variant.description: Inflicts Earth damage on enemies and attracts the targets towards the caster in an area of effect.

primary.name: Catalepsy
primary.description: Steals HP in the Earth element and removes Dodge in an area of effect.

variant.name: Apostasy
variant.description: Moves the caster away from the target, repels it, and inflicts Fire damage on enemies.

primary.name: Coward Mask
primary.description:
Applies the Coward Mask on the caster:
• Applies the Cowardly state on the caster.
• Increases the MP and Dodge of the caster and their allies (excluding Masqueraiders) in an area of effect.

variant.name: Poltroon Mask
variant.description:
Applies the Poltroon Mask on the caster:
• Increases the ranged damage and Range of the caster and their allies (excluding Masqueraiders) in an area of effect.

primary.name: Brincaderia
primary.description: Inflicts Fire damage and removes Dodge.

variant.name: Picada
variant.description: Inflicts Air damage and removes AP.

primary.name: Shove Off
primary.description: Moves the caster away from the target, inflicts Fire, Earth, Water and Air damage on enemies, and repels the target.

variant.name: Pivot
variant.description: Teleports the caster symmetrically relative to the target.

primary.name: Psychopath Mask
primary.description:
Applies the Psychopath Mask on the caster:
• Applies the Psychopathic state on the caster.
• Increases the close-combat damage and Lock of the caster and their allies (excluding Masqueraiders) in an area of effect.

variant.name: Hysterical Mask
variant.description:
Applies the Hysterical Mask on the caster:
• Increases the Pushback Damage of the caster and their allies (excluding Masqueraiders) in an area of effect.
• Repels targets in an area of effect.

primary.name: Furia
primary.description:
Inflicts Earth damage and increases the caster's Damage.
The damage does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Bocciara
variant.description:
Inflicts Water damage on enemies and increases the caster's pushback damage.
The damage does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Capering
primary.description:
Teleports the caster to the targeted cell or symmetrically in relation to the target and inflicts Air damage on enemies in an area of effect.
The area-of-effect damage does not decrease with distance.

variant.name: Purgatorio
variant.description: Reduces effect duration on the target and inflicts Fire damage on enemies.

primary.name: Tortoruga
primary.description:
Applies a shield on the targeted ally.
The shield is halved on summons.

variant.name: Armadur
variant.description: Increases the targeted ally's MP and Dodge.

primary.name: Bling
primary.description: Moves the caster closer to the target.

variant.name: Scudo
variant.description:
Applies a shield on the targeted ally.
The shield is halved on summons.

primary.name: Apathy
primary.description: Inflicts Earth damage and removes MP.

variant.name: Retention
variant.description: Steals HP in the Air element and removes AP.

primary.name: Plastron
primary.description:
Applies a shield around allies in an area of effect.
The shield is halved on summons.

variant.name: Ginga
variant.description:
Applies a shield on the targeted ally and makes the target Unmovable.
The shield is halved on summons.

primary.name: Ardour
primary.description: Makes the targeted ally Unlockable or makes the targeted enemy Unhealable.

variant.name: Masquerade
variant.description:
Inflicts Neutral damage on the caster and the target:
• The damage inflicted on the target depends on the caster's remaining health.
• The damage inflicted on the caster depends on how much health they are missing.
• The effects are inverted if the caster is below 50% health.

On the caster: switches places with their Grimacing Mask.

primary.name: Stampede
primary.description: Teleports the caster to the targeted cell and increases their MP.

variant.name: Comedy
variant.description: Teleports the targets symmetrically in relation to the centre, then repels them in an area of effect.

primary.name: Parafuso
primary.description: Steals HP in the Water element from enemies and attracts targets towards the centre in an area of effect.

variant.name: Martelo
variant.description: Inflicts Earth damage and removes MP in an area of effect.

primary.name: Ponteira
primary.description: Inflicts Water damage and removes damage.

variant.name: Agular
variant.description:
Reduces the healing received by the targets and inflicts Air damage in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Trance
primary.description:
Sacrifices some of the caster's health to apply a shield on allies in an area of effect.
The shield is halved on summons.

variant.name: Neurosis
variant.description: Increases the targeted ally's Power and applies the Gravity state to the target.

primary.name: Cavalcade
primary.description: Moves the caster closer to the target and inflicts Air damage on enemies.

variant.name: Decoy
variant.description: Attracts the target and steals HP in the Fire element from enemies.

primary.name: Inferno
primary.description:
Inflicts Fire damage and increases the caster's Power.
The damage does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Distance
variant.description: Inflicts Water damage on enemies and repels the target.

primary.name: Carnavalo
primary.description:
Applies a shield on the caster, inflicts damage in the caster's best attack element on enemies, and repels the target.
The effects become stronger based on the mask worn by the caster:
• Intrepid: shield is strongest.
• Coward: pushback is strongest.
• Psychopath: damage is strongest.

Each mask change reduces the spell's cooldown period by 1 turn.

variant.name: Transfiguration
variant.description:
Applies the Transfiguration state on the caster and the targeted enemy, and applies effects on the enemy depending on which mask is worn:
• Intrepid: reduces final damage inflicted.
• Coward: reduces ranged resistances.
• Psychopath: reduces close-combat resistances.
Stacking is shared among effects.

Each mask change reduces the spell's cooldown period by 1 turn and reapplies the spell's effects as long as the caster is in the state.

primary.name: Intrepid Mask
primary.description:
Applies the Intrepid Mask on the caster:
• Applies the Intrepid state on the caster.
• Increases the AP of the caster and their allies (excluding Masqueraiders) in a 1-cell cross.
• Attracts entities towards the centre in an area of effect.

variant.name: Tireless Mask
variant.description:
Applies the Tireless Mask on the caster:
• Applies a shield on the caster.
• Increases the AP of the caster and their allies (excluding Masqueraiders) in an area of effect.

primary.name: Grimace
primary.description:
Summons a biddable Grimacing Mask that locks enemies and shares its damage with its summoner as long as it is alive.
When an enemy is locked by the Mask, the mask and its summoner gain shield.

The Grimacing Mask also applies effects depending on the mask worn by its summoner:
• Intrepid: attracts entities in an area of effect around it.
• Coward: increases its MP.
• Psychopath: repels adjacent entities.

The Mask is teleported to the targeted cell if the spell is cast when it is alive.
When it dies, the spell's cooldown period is set to 2 turns.

variant.name: Diffraction
variant.description:
Applies shield on everyone depending on distance from the caster:
• 0 to 5 cells, 450% of level as shield.
• 6 to 11 cells, 250% of level as shield.
• 12 or more cells, 50% of level as shield.
The shield is halved on summons.

breeds.name: Foggernaut
breeds.description: The Foggernauts have more than one turret up their sleeves. Excellent tacticians, they use technomagic to control the battlefield. These marine inventors in their shining diving suits worship the Great Oktapodas, Protector of the Oceans.

primary.name: Torpedo
primary.description: Inflicts Air damage on enemies and repels the target.

variant.name: Rudder
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage on enemies and attracts the targets up to the centre in an area of effect.
The area-of-effect damage does not decrease with distance.

Gives 1 AP back to the caster if a Turret is in the area of effect.

primary.name: Spyglass
primary.description:
Inflicts Water damage on enemies and applies effects based on the Tide:
• Low Tide: increases the caster's and the targeted ally's Range.
• High Tide: removes MP from enemies.

variant.name: Corrosion
variant.description: Inflicts Air damage and reduces Pushback Resistance.

primary.name: Mooring
primary.description:
Inflicts Earth damage on enemies and attracts the target.

Gives 1 AP back to the caster if the spell is cast on a Turret.

variant.name: Valve
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage and reduces Critical odds.

On a Turret: applies effects on enemies in an area of effect and downgrades the Turret to reduce its cooldown period.
• Evolution III: 3-cell circle.
• Evolution II: 2-cell circle.
• Evolution I: 1-cell circle. The Turret's cooldown period is not reduced.

primary.name: Evolution
primary.description:
Evolves and heals one Turret.
Healing is greater on an evolving Turret.

On an ally: increases their Power.

variant.name: Hypertension
variant.description:
Heals one Turret and evolves it to maximum level.
Healing is greater on an evolving Turret.

On an ally: increases their Power.

primary.name: Breakwater
primary.description:
Applies the Automatic state on a Turret and heals it:
• The Turret intercepts close-combat damage suffered by allies adjacent to it when the spell is cast.
• If one of those allies suffers ranged damage, the Turret activates, using its automatic spell on the ally or their attacker.

This activation can only be triggered once per target per turn, and only if the ally or attacker is within the Turret's range.

variant.name: Recursiveness
variant.description:
Repels the target.
If the target ends its movement next to a Turret, that Turret teleports it symmetrically and reapplies the spell's effects on it.

The initial pushback does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Scaphander
primary.description:
Applies a shield around the caster and Turrets and makes them Unlockable.
The shield is greater on the caster.

variant.name: Armour-Plating
variant.description:
Applies a shield on the targeted ally and makes them Unmovable.
The shield is greater on Turrets.

primary.name: Anchor
primary.description:
Inflicts Earth damage and removes MP from enemies in an area of effect.
The area-of-effect damage does not decrease with distance.

Gives 1 AP back to the caster if a Turret is in the area of effect.

variant.name: Short-Circuit
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect around a Turret.

Also evolves the Turret and increases its Critical odds.

primary.name: Lifesaver
primary.description: Places a defensive turret that heals.

variant.name: Drill
variant.description: Places an offensive Turret that steals health in the caster's best element.

primary.name: Torrent
primary.description:
Inflicts Water damage on enemies and moves the target based on the Tide:
• Low Tide: attracts the target.
• High Tide: repels the target.

A given target can only be affected once by the movement of a Tide during the current turn.

variant.name: Harmattan
variant.description:
Repels the target and inflicts Air damage on enemies.
Rebounds on entities adjacent to the target.

primary.name: Hoofbeat
primary.description:
Inflicts Fire damage and removes Damage from enemies in an area of effect.
The spell's damage increases for each evolved Turret in the area of effect before applying effects.

Downgrades Turrets that are hit to reduce their cooldown period.

variant.name: Periscope
variant.description:
Inflicts Water damage on enemies and applies the Seasickness state on them:
• Steals MP if the target is attracted, pushed or transposed (stackable 3 times).

• Low Tide: disables the spell's modifiable range and line of sight.
• High Tide: makes its range modifiable and activates its line of sight.

primary.name: Assistance
primary.description:
Teleports the allied target to the first cell available between the caster and it. 
Also heals the target if it is a Turret.

variant.name: Signal Box
variant.description:
Attracts the target towards the nearest Turret in a 5-cell cross around it.
If the target ends its movement next to a Turret, that Turret teleports it symmetrically and reapplies the spell's effects on it.

primary.name: Grapnel
primary.description:
Moves the caster closer to the targeted ally.
The movement is greater on Turrets.

variant.name: Piston
variant.description:
Moves the caster away from the target.
The backward movement is greater on Turrets.

primary.name: Tacturret
primary.description: Places a tactical Turret that repels targets in an area of effect.

variant.name: Bathyscaphe
variant.description: Places a defensive Turret that applies shield.

primary.name: Harpooner
primary.description: Places an offensive Turret that steals health in the caster's best element.

variant.name: Trawler
variant.description: Places a tactical Turret that attracts targets in an area of effect around it and can lock.

primary.name: First Aid
primary.description:
Activates the caster's defensive Turrets' special spells on the targeted ally.

Heals the target in the caster's best element.

variant.name: Rescue
variant.description:
Activates the caster's defensive Turrets' special spells on the targeted ally.

Heals the target.

primary.name: Trident
primary.description: Inflicts Air damage on enemies and repels targets outwards in an area of effect.

variant.name: Capstan
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage on enemies and attracts the targets up to the centre in an area of effect.
Also teleports entities symmetrically in relation to the centre if the spell targets a Turret.

The area-of-effect damage does not decrease with distance.
The attraction does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Sonar
primary.description:
Activates the caster's offensive Turrets' special spells on the targeted enemy.

Inflicts damage on enemies in the caster's best element.

On an ally: pushes targets away from the centre and reveals invisible entities in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

variant.name: Ambush
variant.description:
Activates the caster's offensive Turrets' special spells on the target.

Inflicts Water, Earth, Air and Fire damage.

primary.name: Compass
primary.description:
Switches the positions of the first and last target in the area of effect.

On the caster: teleports adjacent entities symmetrically in relation to them.

variant.name: Compass
variant.description:
Teleports the caster symmetrically relative to a Turret.

On a cell adjacent to a Turret: teleports the caster to the targeted cell or switches places with the target.

primary.name: Turbine
primary.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and attracts the targets up to the centre in an area of effect.

Also evolves Turrets in the area of effect.

variant.name: Pilfer
variant.description:
Inflicts Air damage and applies the Pilfer state on the targeted enemy:
• Inflicts Air damage on enemies in an area of effect and removes the state if the target suffers pushback damage.

primary.name: Dive
primary.description:
Activates the caster's tactical Turrets' special spells on the target.

Removes MP from enemies.

variant.name: Submersion
variant.description:
Activates the caster's tactical Turrets' special spells on the target.

Removes Range from enemies.

primary.name: Backwash
primary.description:
Inflicts Earth damage on enemies and repels the target.

Gives 2 AP back to the caster and the pushback inflicts no damage if the spell is cast on a Turret.

variant.name: Froth
variant.description:
Inflicts Water damage on enemies and moves the targets based on the Tide in an area of effect:
• Low Tide: attracts the targets.
• High Tide: repels the targets.

primary.name: Tide
primary.description:
Switches places with the target and inflicts Water damage on enemies.

On the caster: modifies the Tide state and reimburses the AP cost and use of the spell.
This effect can be triggered up to 2 times per turn.

variant.name: Vapour
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and repels targets from the centre in an area of effect.

Also evolves Turrets in the area of effect.

breeds.name: Eliotrope
breeds.description: Appearing accidentally, Eliotropes are reflections of their creator, the God-King. They move with the speed of lightning, and disappear in the blink of an eye only to reappear where you least expect them. Just like Eliatropes, they've mastered the secrets of Wakfu.

primary.name: Portal
primary.description:
Places a portal.

When several portals are active, you can use them to teleport or project spells.
Portals increase projected spells' damage and healing.

The caster's final damage and healing increase when they cast a spell through a portal (stackable 10 times).
Enemy fighters cannot go through a portal on the first turn.

variant.name: Wandering
variant.description:
Places a portal.

When several portals are active, you can use them to teleport or project spells.
Portals increase projected spells' damage and healing.

The caster's final damage and healing increase when they cast a spell through a portal (stackable 10 times).
Enemy fighters cannot go through a portal on the first turn.

primary.name: Insult
primary.description:
Inflicts Air damage on enemies and repels targets in an area of effect. 
Pushback does not happen if the spell is cast through a portal.

variant.name: Contempt
variant.description: Inflicts Air damage on enemies and repels targets in an area of effect.

primary.name: Audacious
primary.description:
Moves the caster closer to the target and inflicts Water damage on enemies.
The caster is not moved closer if the spell is cast through a portal.

variant.name: Tribulation
variant.description: Inflicts Water damage on enemies and attracts targets towards the middle in an area of effect.

primary.name: Shock
primary.description:
Inflicts Earth damage on enemies and attracts the targets towards the centre in an area of effect.
The attraction affects the caster only if the spell is cast through a portal.

variant.name: Convulsion
variant.description: Inflicts Earth damage on enemies and pushes targets outwards in an area of effect.

primary.name: Wakfu Ray
primary.description: Heals allies and inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect.

variant.name: Lazybeam
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage in an area of effect.
The damage becomes a health steal if the spell is cast through a portal.

Does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Neutral
primary.description:
Deactivates a portal.

The spell's AP cost is reimbursed.

variant.name: Interruption
variant.description: Deactivates all portals.

primary.name: Affront
primary.description:
Inflicts Fire damage.
Also increases the caster's Range if the spell is cast through a portal.

variant.name: Composure
variant.description:
Inflicts Water damage.
Also increases the caster's MP if the spell is cast through a portal.

primary.name: Transcendence
primary.description: Makes the caster Unlockable and increases the number of casts per turn of the Portal spell or the maximum Range of the Wandering spell.

variant.name: Exile
variant.description: Places and activates a portal under the target.

primary.name: Therapy
primary.description: Steals HP in the Earth element from enemies or heals the targeted ally and attracts the target.

variant.name: Lightning Fist
variant.description:
Inflicts Water damage on enemies and repels the target.
The pushback is greater if the spell is cast through a portal.

primary.name: Distribution
primary.description: Allies are healed for some of the damage inflicted on the target in an area of effect around it.

variant.name: Pride
variant.description:
Applies the Pride state on the targeted ally:
• Reflects part of the damage suffered by the target onto their attacker.

Increases the target's Power on the following turn.

primary.name: Choppy Wake
primary.description: Places a portal under the caster and teleports them to the targeted cell.

variant.name: Stupor
variant.description: Places two portals under the caster and the target and switches places with the target.

primary.name: Bullying
primary.description:
Inflicts Air damage on enemies in an area of effect and pushes targets back from the centre of the area of effect.
The pushback affects the caster only if the spell is cast through a portal.

variant.name: Cataclysm
variant.description: Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and heals allies based on the damage inflicted in an area of effect.

primary.name: Healing
primary.description: Heals allies in an area of effect.

variant.name: Conjuration
variant.description:
Reduces the duration of effects on the target.
Also reduces heals received by the targeted enemy if the spell is cast through a portal.

primary.name: Insolence
primary.description:
Moves the caster away from the target and inflicts Water damage on enemies.
The backward movement does not happen if the spell is cast through a portal.

variant.name: Snub
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage on enemies in an area of effect.
Also removes Damage from enemies in an area of effect if the spell is cast through a portal.

primary.name: Odyssey
primary.description:
On an enemy: moves the caster away from the target and attracts the target.
On an ally: pushes the target back and moves the caster closer to it.

variant.name: Exodus
variant.description: Teleports the caster symmetrically in relation to the target.

primary.name: Cabal
primary.description:
Increases allies' Power and MP in an area of effect.
The bonus is greater if the spell is cast through a portal.

variant.name: Resilience
variant.description:
Heals the targeted ally.
Also increases their heals received if the spell is cast through a portal.

primary.name: Affliction
primary.description:
Steals HP in the Water element from enemies or heals the targeted ally.
If the spell is cast through a portal: also applies a start-of-turn Water poison on the targeted enemy or heals the targeted ally when their turn starts.

variant.name: Offence
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

primary.name: Resonance
primary.description:
Applies the Resonance state on the target:
• Places and activates a portal under the target on the first attack suffered.

variant.name: Vestige
variant.description:
Summons an Eliotrope Totem that can place and activate a portal under its allied attacker and increase its MP (stackable 2 times).
The Totem heals itself when an entity passes through a portal.

There can only be one Eliotrope Totem per team. If the Totem is still on the field when summoned again, the old one is destroyed to make room for the new one.

primary.name: Persiflage
primary.description:
Removes Range and inflicts Earth damage.
The removal becomes a steal if the spell is cast through a portal.

variant.name: Sinecure
variant.description:
Steals HP in the Air element from enemies or heals the targeted ally.
Also reduces the targeted enemy's Pushback Resistance if the spell is cast through a portal.

primary.name: Extinction
primary.description:
Inflicts Fire damage.
If the spell is cast through a portal: also applies an end-of-turn Fire poison on the target.

variant.name: Sermon
variant.description:
Inflicts Air damage on enemies and repels the target.
The pushback is greater if the spell is cast through a portal.

primary.name: Ridicule
primary.description:
Inflicts Air damage.
Also removes MP if the spell is cast through a portal.

variant.name: Sarcasm
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage. 
Also removes AP if the spell is cast through a portal.

primary.name: Mutual Assistance
primary.description:
Applies the Mutual Assistance state on the caster, which applies effects when an entity passes through a portal: 
• Increases the caster's AP.
• Heals the caster and their allies in an area of effect around the caster.

variant.name: Coalition
variant.description:
Increases the targeted ally's AP and applies the Coalition state on them:
• Heals the target when it passes through a portal.

The bonus is greater if the spell is cast through a portal.

breeds.name: Huppermage
breeds.description: Huppermages are able to combine Fire, Air, Water and Earth to cast spells with multiple effects. Masters of elemental runes, they honour the Krosmic Balance, a mysterious force that aims to maintain balance in the universe.

primary.name: Seismic Shockwave
primary.description:
Inflicts Earth damage and removes MP.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

variant.name: Ember
variant.description:
Inflicts Fire damage.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

primary.name: Ether
primary.description:
Inflicts Air damage and removes Range.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

variant.name: Cataract
variant.description:
Inflicts Water damage.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

primary.name: Runification
primary.description:
Triggers one of the caster's runes to steal health from the enemy or heal the ally occupying it, and increase the characteristics of the caster and the ally on the rune based on the rune's element.

On the caster: triggers all runes occupied by an entity.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

variant.name: Manifestation
variant.description:
Triggers one of the caster's runes to steal health from the enemy or heal the ally occupying it, and increase the characteristics of the caster and the ally on the rune based on the rune's element.

If the cell is free or becomes free:
• [Terre] Earth: pushes entities from the rune in an area of effect.
• [Feu] Fire: teleports the caster to the rune.
• [Eau] Water: attracts entities towards the rune in an area of effect.
• [Air] Air: teleports entities symmetrically in relation to the rune in an area of effect.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

primary.name: Flamethrower
primary.description:
Inflicts Fire damage and removes AP.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

variant.name: Telluric Lances
variant.description:
Inflicts Earth damage.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

primary.name: Stalagmite
primary.description:
Inflicts Water damage and reduces final damage.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

variant.name: Celestial Wave
variant.description:
Inflicts Air damage.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

primary.name: Storm
primary.description:
Repels targets from the centre and inflicts Earth damage on enemies in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

variant.name: Hurricane
variant.description:
Inflicts Air damage and removes AP.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

primary.name: Sun Lance
primary.description:
Switches places with the target and inflicts Fire damage on enemies.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

variant.name: Comet
variant.description:
Applies effects based on the caster's position in relation to the target and inflicts Air damage on enemies:
• Moves the caster away from the target if the caster is in close combat.
• Teleports the caster up to target if the caster is at a distance.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

primary.name: Polarity
primary.description:
Consumes the elemental state on the targeted enemy to apply effects based on their elemental state:
• [Terre] Earth: repels the target.
• [Feu] Fire: switches places with the target.
• [Eau] Water: attracts the target.
• [Air] Air: teleports the caster symmetrically in relation to the target.

variant.name: Convection
variant.description:
Consumes the elemental state on the targeted enemy to apply effects based on their elemental state:
• [Terre] Earth: moves the caster away from the target.
• [Feu] Fire: teleports the target and caster to their previous positions.
• [Eau] Water: moves the caster closer to the target.
• [Air] Air: teleports the target symmetrically in relation to the caster.

primary.name: Burning Stroke
primary.description:
Repels targets and inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

variant.name: Stalactite
variant.description:
Inflicts Water damage and removes MP.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

primary.name: Glacier
primary.description:
Attracts targets towards the centre and steals HP in the Water element from enemies in an area of effect.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

variant.name: Volcano
variant.description:
Steals HP in the Fire element and increases the damage suffered by the target.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

primary.name: Propagation
primary.description:
Applies effects and spreads states to enemies in an area of effect based on the elemental state of the targeted enemy:
• [Terre] Earth: reduces Pushback Resistance.
• [Feu] Fire: removes Critical.
• [Eau] Water: removes Dodge.
• [Air] Air: removes Lock.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

variant.name: Runic Prism
variant.description:
Triggers one of the caster's runes to apply effects and an elemental state on enemies based on its element in an area of effect:
• [Terre] Earth: reduces the duration of effects on the targets.
• [Feu] Fire: reduces healing received by the targets.
• [Eau] Water: erodes the targets.
• [Air] Air: heals the targets' attackers.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

primary.name: Elemental Shield
primary.description:
Increases the targeted ally's resistance and applies the Elemental Shield state on the ally:
• Reduces the target's resistance in the element of the attack suffered by the target.
• Applies an elemental state on its attacker based on the element of the attack.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

variant.name: Elemental Guardian
variant.description:
Summons a biddable Elemental Guardian that can inflict damage, place runes and change elemental states.

When the caster generates an elemental combination, the Guardian gains effects based on the combination.

primary.name: Astral Blade
primary.description:
Teleports the caster symmetrically in relation to the target and inflicts Air damage on enemies.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

variant.name: Deflagration
variant.description:
Teleports the target and the caster to their previous positions and inflicts Fire damage on enemies.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

primary.name: Contribution
primary.description:
Places a rune and applies effects on the targeted ally based on the elemental states of all the enemies:
• [Terre] Earth: increases MP.
• [Feu] Fire: applies a shield.
• [Eau] Water: increases Power.
• [Air] Air: increases AP.

Consumes all elemental states.

variant.name: Imprint
variant.description:
Consumes the elemental state on the targeted enemy to place a rune in the state's element.

On the caster: applies the effects on all enemies.

Otherwise: places a rune in the same element as the last rune placed by the caster.

Using the spell on a free cell is only possible once per turn.

primary.name: Flood
primary.description:
Moves the caster closer to the target and inflicts Water damage on enemies.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

variant.name: Asteroid
variant.description:
Moves the caster away from the target and inflicts Earth damage on enemies.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

primary.name: Runic Overcharge
primary.description: Triggers all the caster's runes to inflict damage on the enemy or heal the targeted ally in the rune's element for each rune triggered.

variant.name: Sublimation
variant.description:
Applies the Gravity and Sublimation states on the targeted enemy:
• Increases the attacker's characteristics and applies a state on the target based on the element of the attack the target suffers (stackable 4 times).

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

primary.name: Flurry
primary.description:
Teleports targets symmetrically in relation to the centre and steals HP in the Air element from enemies in an area of effect.
Does not directly affect the caster.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

variant.name: Breach
variant.description:
Steals HP in the Earth element and removes Range.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

primary.name: Meteor
primary.description:
Repels the target and inflicts Earth damage on enemies.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

variant.name: Avalanche
variant.description:
Attracts the target and inflicts Water damage on enemies.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

primary.name: Elemental Cycle
primary.description:
Changes the elemental state on the targeted enemy clockwise based on their current state:
• [Terre] Earth → [Eau] Water → [Feu] Fire → [Air] Air → [Terre] Earth

On an enemy without an elemental state: applies the elemental state of the last rune placed by the caster.

The spell's AP cost is reimbursed the first time a target changes states.

variant.name: Quadramental Current
variant.description:
Changes the elemental state on the targeted enemy counter-clockwise based on their current state:
• [Eau] Water → [Terre] Earth → [Air] Air → [Feu] Fire → [Eau] Water

On an enemy without an elemental state: applies the elemental state of the last rune placed by the caster.

The spell's AP cost is reimbursed the first time a target changes states.

primary.name: Journey
primary.description: Teleports the caster to the targeted cell and inflicts damage on enemies in an area of effect based on their elemental state.

variant.name: Runic Repulsion
variant.description:
Repels targets in an area of effect.
Also triggers all the caster's runes to repel targets again for each rune triggered.

The pushback decreases with each rune.

primary.name: Elemental Drain
primary.description: Steals characteristics and health based on the targeted enemy's elemental state.

variant.name: Tribute
variant.description:
Applies effects on the caster based on the elemental state on the targeted enemy and inflicts damage in the caster's best element:
• [Terre] Earth: increases MP.
• [Feu] Fire: applies a shield.
• [Eau] Water: increases Power.
• [Air] Air: increases AP.

primary.name: Supernova
primary.description:
Reduces the duration of effects on the target and inflicts damage on enemies in the caster's best and worst elements.
Places a rune in the worst element.

Can generate Elemental Combinations.

variant.name: Arcane Torrent
variant.description:
Inflicts Air, Earth, Fire and Water damage on enemies in an area of effect.
The spell's damage increases with each elemental combination generated by the caster.

The effects are reset after the spell is used.

breeds.name: Ouginak
breeds.description: When you're a barbarian with the nature of a bow wow, you have to know how to bare your teeth to get respected. A proud look, a shiny coat, a wet nose: that's how Ouginaks face their trials and overcome adversity. Relentlessly tracking their prey, letting their rage explode to crush their enemies, watching them die and listening to the terrorised miaowing of their bow meows... That's a life worth living!

primary.name: Convergence
primary.description: Moves the caster closer to the targeted ally or attracts the targeted enemy.

variant.name: Tailing
variant.description: Pushes the target back and moves the caster closer to it.

primary.name: Prey
primary.description:
Applies the Prey state on the targeted enemy.
Entities who attack the target are healed by some of the damage inflicted.

If the Prey is killed, sets the spell's cooldown period to 0.

variant.name: Venison
variant.description:
Applies the Prey state on the targeted enemy and increases its damage suffered.

If the Prey is killed, sets the spell's cooldown period to 0.

primary.name: Watchdog
primary.description:
Inflicts Earth damage on enemies and reduces damage suffered by the caster.

Increases Rage (requires a target).

variant.name: Jaw
variant.description:
Increases the caster's and allies' MP Parry, removes MP Parry and inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect.

Increases Rage.

primary.name: Ulna
primary.description:
Steals HP in the Water element.
If the target is the Prey: gives 1 MP to the caster.

The spell is not subject to casting conditions in Animal Form.

variant.name: Calcaneus
variant.description:
